jobs.title: (Remote) Project Manager, Professional Services
jobs.description:
Advanced Utility Systems, a division of Harris; is seeking a Project Manager who is experienced, bilingual in English and French, and capable of leading enterprise software implementation projects for utility organizations across North America.

The successful candidate will be accountable for delivering projects on time, within budget, and to customer expectations while managing project scope, risks, financial performance, stakeholder engagement, and overall project governance.

This role requires a strong delivery leader who can build trusted client relationships, drive cross-functional collaboration, and execute with discipline in a fast-paced consulting environment. As part of our commitment to innovation and continuous improvement, Project Managers are expected to leverage modern AI technologies to enhance project delivery, improve productivity, strengthen reporting and forecasting, and drive better customer outcomes while maintaining accountability for all deliverables.

This remote role welcomes candidates anywhere in Canada and the US. Travel is required as needed, approximately 50%. Candidates must hold a current, valid passport and be legally eligible to travel internationally. This includes either passport based visa exemption or possession of any required travel visas for entry into Canada, the United States, and the Caribbean. Preference will be given to candidates who can work in EST but needs to be able to adapt for across America as required.

Salary

80K - 100K

AI & Innovation Mindset

We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and drive business outcomes. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt and leverage AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and increase efficiency. Candidates should be comfortable using AI enabled technologies, including copilots, chat based AI assistants, and automation tools, as part of their everyday work while maintaining appropriate judgment, security, and compliance standards.

What Your Impact Will Be

Lead software implementation and upgrade projects from initiation through go-live and post-production stabilization.
Manage project scope, schedule, budget, risks, issues, dependencies, and customer expectations.
Serve as the primary customer-facing point of contact and trusted advisor.
Facilitate project status meetings, executive steering committees, and governance reviews.
Coordinate cross-functional teams including consulting, technical, conversion, reporting, training, testing, and support resources.
Monitor project financial performance, forecasts, profitability, and change orders.
Ensure compliance with PMO methodologies, standards, and governance requirements.
Drive proactive risk management, issue resolution, and continuous improvement initiatives.

What We Are Looking For

Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
Minimum 5 years of Project Management experience leading enterprise software implementation projects.
Proven experience managing project scope, schedule, budget, resources, and stakeholder relationships.
Strong executive communication, facilitation, and presentation skills.
Fully bilingual in English and French (written and verbal) with the ability to communicate effectively with customers, executives, and project teams in both languages.
Proficiency with Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Excel, and project management tools.
Demonstrated experience using modern AI technologies to improve project delivery, reporting, documentation, communication, forecasting, or operational efficiency.
Ability and willingness to travel up to 50% throughout North America.

What Would Make You Stand Out

PMP Certification.
Utility industry experience.
CIS, ERP, SaaS, Asset Management, or enterprise software implementation experience.
Experience with change management and organizational transformation.
Experience developing automation, AI-enabled workflows, delivery accelerators, or process improvements.

What We Can Offer

3 weeks’ vacation and 5 personal days
Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits starting from your first day of employment
Employee stock ownership and RRSP/401k matching programs
Lifestyle rewards
Remote work and more!

About Advanced Utility Systems

Advanced Utility Systems was established in 1997 to provide Customer Information and Billing solutions exclusively to municipal, investor owned and cooperative utilities. With more than 150 successful customer deployments across North America, Central America, South America and the Caribbean, Advanced has the experience required to deliver a successful implementation of your mission critical CIS.

About Harris

Harris is a leading provider of mission critical software to the public sector in North America. As a wholly owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc. (“CSI”, symbol CSU on the TSX), Harris has become the cornerstone for CSI’s investment in utility, local government, school districts, public safety, and healthcare software verticals. Our success has been realized through investments in our proprietary software and market expertise. This focus, combined with acquiring businesses that build upon or complement our offerings, has helped drive our success. Harris will continue to growth through reinvestment – both in the people and products that we offer and making investments in acquiring new businesses.

Advanced Utility Systems, une division de Harris, est à la recherche d’un gestionnaire de projet expérimenté, parfaitement bilingue en français et en anglais, capable de diriger des projets d’implantation de logiciels d’entreprise auprès d’organisations de services publics partout en Amérique du Nord.

La personne retenue sera responsable de livrer les projets dans les délais prévus, selon les budgets établis et conformément aux attentes des clients. Elle assurera également la gestion de la portée des projets, des risques, de la performance financière, des parties prenantes et de la gouvernance globale des projets.

Ce poste s’adresse à une personne reconnue pour son leadership en matière de livraison, capable d’établir des relations de confiance avec les clients, de favoriser une collaboration efficace entre différentes équipes et de mener les projets avec rigueur dans un environnement de consultation dynamique. Dans le cadre de notre engagement envers l’innovation et l’amélioration continue, nos gestionnaires de projet sont également appelés à utiliser les technologies modernes d’IA afin d’améliorer l’exécution des projets, d’accroître la productivité, de renforcer les activités de suivi, de production de rapports et de prévisions, et d’obtenir de meilleurs résultats pour nos clients, tout en demeurant responsables de l’ensemble des livrables.

Ce poste est entièrement à distance et est ouvert aux personnes résidant partout au Canada et aux États Unis. Des déplacements sont requis selon les besoins et peuvent représenter environ 50 % du temps. Les candidats doivent détenir un passeport valide et être légalement autorisés à voyager à l’international. Cela comprend soit une exemption de visa liée au passeport, soit la possession de tout visa requis pour entrer au Canada, aux États Unis et dans les Caraïbes. Une préférence sera accordée aux candidats pouvant travailler principalement selon l’heure de l’Est, tout en étant en mesure d’adapter leur horaire afin de collaborer avec des équipes et des clients situés partout dans les Amériques.

Salaire

80 000 $ à 100 000 $

Mentalité axée sur l’IA et l’innovation

Nous nous engageons à tirer parti des technologies émergentes afin d’améliorer nos façons de travailler, de mieux servir nos clients et de générer de meilleurs résultats d’affaires. La personne retenue devra faire preuve de curiosité et démontrer une volonté d’adopter activement les outils d’IA afin d’améliorer les processus de travail, de résoudre des problèmes et d’accroître l’efficacité.

Les candidats doivent être à l’aise avec l’utilisation de technologies propulsées par l’IA, notamment les copilotes, les assistants conversationnels fondés sur l’IA et les outils d’automatisation, dans le cadre de leurs activités quotidiennes, tout en respectant les normes appropriées en matière de jugement professionnel, de sécurité et de conformité.

Votre impact

Diriger des projets d’implantation et de mise à niveau de logiciels, depuis leur lancement jusqu’à la mise en production et à la stabilisation après le déploiement.

Gérer la portée, l’échéancier, le budget, les risques, les enjeux, les dépendances et les attentes des clients.

Agir comme principal point de contact auprès des clients et comme conseiller de confiance.

Animer les rencontres de suivi de projet, les comités directeurs de direction et les revues de gouvernance.

Coordonner des équipes multidisciplinaires comprenant notamment des ressources en consultation, en services techniques, en conversion de données, en production de rapports, en formation, en assurance qualité et en soutien.

Surveiller la performance financière des projets, les prévisions, la rentabilité et les demandes de modification.

Assurer le respect des méthodologies, des normes et des exigences de gouvernance du PMO.

Favoriser une gestion proactive des risques, une résolution efficace des enjeux et la mise en œuvre d’initiatives d’amélioration continue.

Ce que nous recherchons

Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, en technologies de l’information, en génie ou dans un domaine connexe.

Minimum de 5 années d’expérience en gestion de projet, notamment dans la direction de projets d’implantation de logiciels d’entreprise.

Expérience démontrée dans la gestion de la portée, des échéanciers, des budgets, des ressources et des relations avec les parties prenantes.

Excellentes compétences en communication avec la haute direction, en animation de rencontres et en présentation.

Parfaitement bilingue en français et en anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, avec la capacité de communiquer efficacement avec les clients, les membres de la direction et les équipes de projet dans les 2 langues.

Maîtrise de Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Excel et des outils de gestion de projet.

Expérience démontrée dans l’utilisation de technologies modernes d’IA afin d’améliorer la livraison de projets, la production de rapports, la documentation, les communications, les prévisions ou l’efficacité opérationnelle.

Capacité et volonté de voyager jusqu’à 50 % du temps partout en Amérique du Nord.

Ce qui vous démarquera

Certification PMP.

Expérience dans le secteur des services publics.

Expérience avec les systèmes CIS, ERP, SaaS, les solutions de gestion des actifs ou l’implantation de logiciels d’entreprise.

Expérience en gestion du changement et en transformation organisationnelle.

Expérience dans le développement d’automatisations, de processus intégrant l’IA, d’outils permettant d’accélérer la livraison ou d’améliorations de processus.

Ce que nous offrons

3 semaines de vacances et 5 journées personnelles.

Régime complet d’assurance médicale, dentaire et soins de la vue dès votre première journée d’emploi.

Programme d’actionnariat des employés ainsi que programmes de cotisation équivalente au REER ou au 401(k).

Programme de récompenses mieux être et style de vie.

Travail à distance et bien plus encore.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

The B2B Technical Project Manager
is responsible for leading customer integration projects and supporting the development and implementation of scalable B2B integration solutions between Avantor and its customers.

This role manages technical integration projects throughout the project lifecycle, partners with internal and external stakeholders, evaluates existing business processes and technologies, and identifies opportunities to improve the customer Procure-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash experience.

The B2B Technical Project Manager will also contribute to the development of Avantor's long-term integration strategy, including future connectivity with customer and supplier eProcurement platforms and external portals.

What We're Looking For

Education and Experience:

Bachelor's degree in related discipline or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
5+ years of relevant experience in technical project management, B2B integrations, eCommerce, eProcurement, or a related area.
Experience managing technical integration projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.
Experience working with common customer eProcurement platforms such as Ariba Network, JAGGAER, Hubwoo, Coupa, Oracle Supplier Network, Unimarket, Perfect Commerce, ExpenseWatch, ESM or similar platforms.

THOSE NECESSARY TO PERFORM THE JOB COMPETENTLY

Technical Knowledge And Skills

Solid understanding of the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Order-to-Cash (O2C) business processes.
Strong understanding of B2B integration formats, technologies, and protocols including EDI, cXML, XML, and APIs web services.
Experience with eProcurement integration processes and technologies, including cXML / OCI PunchOut and AS2.
Working knowledge of integration best practices and experience supporting SAP or similar ERP environments.
Ability to analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into scalable integration solutions.
Effective written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational, planning, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to effectively facilitate meetings and conference calls with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Self-Motivated and results-oriented, with strong attention to detail while maintaining perspective on broader business objectives.

How You Will Thrive And Create An Impact

Serve as a primary technical liaison between Avantor, customers, and internal teams for B2B integration initiatives.
Lead customer integration projects from requirements gathering and planning through implementation, testing, deployment, and project closeout.
Partner with customers and internal stakeholders to understand business requirements, technical capabilities, and integration needs.
Develop, document, and continuously improve standardized B2B integration procedures and implementation practices.
Analyze current business processes, systems and integration technologies and recommend opportunities for process or system improvements.
Lead internal and external project teams by establishing project plans, assigning responsibilities, monitoring deliverables, and managing timelines.
Identify project risks, dependencies, and potential issues and coordinate appropriate resolution or escalation.
Ensure projects are completed accurately, efficiently, and within agreed-upon timelines.
Build and maintain effective working relationships with customers, project teams, technology partners, and cross-functional stakeholders.
Support the development of Avantor's future-state B2B integration strategy, including integrations with external eProcurement and supplier platforms.
Maintain appropriate project documentation and provide regular project status updates to stakeholders.
Performs other duties as assigned.

Disclaimer

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. Avantor is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Why Avantor?

Dare to go further in your career.
Join our global team of 14,000+ associates whose passion for discovery and determination to overcome challenges relentlessly advances life-changing science.

The work we do changes people's lives for the better.
It brings new patient treatments and therapies to market, giving a cancer survivor the chance to walk his daughter down the aisle. It enables medical devices that help a little boy hear his mom's voice for the first time. Outcomes such as these create unlimited opportunities for you to contribute your talents, learn new skills and grow your career at Avantor.

We are committed to helping you on this journey through our diverse, equitable and inclusive culture which includes learning experiences to support your career growth and success. At Avantor, dare to go further and see how the impact of your contributions set science in motion to create a better world. Apply today!

Pay Transparency

$78,000.00 - $125,350.00

Actual pay may differ depending on relevant factors such as prior experience and geographic location.

If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please contact us by email at recruiting@avantorsciences.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Requests for accommodation will be considered on a case-by-case basis. Please note that only inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address.

For more information about equal employment opportunity protections, please view the Know Your Rights poster.

A key aspect of this role involves tracking project milestones, managing risks, and ensuring that all stakeholders remain informed through effective communication channels. The Project Manager will also oversee expediting and logistics activities, ensuring timely procurement and delivery of resources. Monitoring inspection schedules and quality checkpoints is crucial to maintaining high standards and compliance with industry regulations. Accurate and comprehensive project documentation is vital for transparency and future reference. The role emphasizes continuous process improvement, encouraging innovative solutions to streamline workflows. Supporting resource allocation and ensuring projects meet client requirements, compliance standards, and organizational quality benchmarks are fundamental responsibilities. This position offers an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented professional with strong leadership skills to contribute to the company's growth and success.

Candidates should possess strong Project Management skills, including planning, execution, risk management, and stakeholder communication.

Candidates should possess Inspection-related skills to coordinate quality checks, verify compliance, and support technical reviews as needed.

Relevant experience managing projects in IT, technology infrastructure, or business consulting environments is highly beneficial.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities, with proficiency in project management tools and collaboration platforms.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a remote, cross-functional, and multicultural setting.
Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, IT, or a related field; professional project management certification (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum) is an advantage.

Develop detailed project plans, including scope, schedule, and resource allocation, to ensure timely and within-budget delivery.

Track project milestones and deliverables, ensuring adherence to deadlines and quality standards.
Manage project risks proactively by identifying potential issues and implementing mitigation strategies.
Oversee expediting activities, ensuring that materials and services are delivered on time to prevent project delays.
Coordinate inspection schedules and quality assurance processes to verify compliance with technical and safety standards.
Maintain accurate project documentation, including reports, logs, and compliance records, for transparency and accountability.

Identify opportunities for process improvements and implement best practices to enhance project delivery workflows.

PROJECT MANAGER
OWN THE PROJECT. LEAD THE TEAM.

Lead planning, budgets, and site delivery while mentoring the next generation of Project Managers.

Buildforth by Paradigm is hiring an experienced Project Manager to lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of residential and mixed-use construction projects. As the general contracting division of the Paradigm Group of Companies, Buildforth brings Paradigm’s innovative building technology to life on site: Future-Ready Homes. Built Today. This is an excellent opportunity for a proven construction leader who wants to own projects from start to finish while helping develop Junior Project Managers.

This is a remote role with schedule flexibility based on project needs. 
You will take full ownership of residential and mixed-use construction projects, managing budgets, schedules, procurement, and site coordination from pre-construction through completion, while mentoring Junior Project Managers and reporting to the Director of Projects. This role requires regular travel to active project sites and offices throughout British Columbia and Alberta, including out-of-town work as project needs require.

AT A GLANCE

Full-time role, Monday to Friday, with flexibility based on project needs

Regular travel to active construction sites and offices throughout British Columbia, including out-of-town work as needed

A mix of project leadership, budget and schedule management, and hands-on presence on site

Reports to the Director of Projects, and mentors Junior Project Managers

Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications

Group benefits, RRSP matching, EAP, annual safety allowance, referral bonus program, and growth opportunities

WHY THIS ROLE STANDS OUT

Own and lead residential and mixed-use projects from pre-construction to completion.

Mentor Junior Project Managers and help shape the next generation of Buildforth’s project leaders.

Work closely with the Director of Projects, design, engineering, and fabrication teams to deliver Future-Ready Homes.

Travel throughout British Columbia and Alberta and build relationships with clients, trades, and project teams.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Lead all phases of project delivery, from pre-construction through final completion.

Develop and manage budgets, schedules, scopes of work, and subcontracts.

Oversee procurement processes and ensure timely delivery of materials and services.

Monitor milestones, critical paths, and deliverables to keep projects on track.

Direct site teams, subcontractors, and consultants, and maintain a regular presence on active job sites.

Collaborate with design, engineering, and fabrication teams, and coordinate between fabrication and site teams for seamless project execution.

Mentor Junior Project Managers and project team members, and promote a strong team culture.

Monitor project budgets, forecast costs, and identify cost-saving opportunities.

Review and approve invoices, change orders, and progress claims.

Support value engineering initiatives and strategic purchasing decisions.

Act as the primary point of contact for clients, consultants, and internal teams, and lead project meetings to keep all stakeholders aligned.

Maintain accurate project records, reports, and documentation.

Identify risks early, develop mitigation strategies, and resolve issues with professionalism, accountability, and agility.

Ensure compliance with contractual, safety, and regulatory requirements.

WHAT YOU BRING

Degree or diploma in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, or a related field.

Minimum 5 years of project management experience in the construction industry.

Proven ability to manage complex contracts and permitting processes.

Experience leading projects in remote or out-of-town locations.

Proficiency in project management software (e.g., Procore, MS Project, or similar).

Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the confidence to coordinate across clients, trades, and internal teams.

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

A collaborative mindset, with a genuine interest in mentoring and developing junior team members.

Valid driver’s licence, reliable transportation, and openness to regular travel and visiting project sites and offices as required across British Columbia and Alberta, including out-of-town work.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.

Mileage and travel expenses reimbursed, including employer-arranged accommodations when applicable to the assignment.

Group benefits, RRSP matching, Employee Assistance Program, annual safety allowance, and referral bonus program.

Team building activities and initiatives.

Opportunities for professional growth and development within Buildforth and the Paradigm Group of Companies.

Varied work, meaningful responsibility, and a collaborative, innovative work environment.

ABOUT BUILDFORTH BY PARADIGM
Future-Ready Homes. Built Today.

Buildforth by Paradigm is the general contracting division that brings this innovative building technology to life on site: an opportunity to be part of a forward-thinking, technology-driven approach to construction.

Paradigm, at the core of the Paradigm Group of Companies (PGC), is an integrated housing and construction group based in Louis Creek, BC (45 minutes from Kamloops), serving clients across Western Canada. We design and build Net Zero, climate-resilient, and fire-resilient homes that combine beauty, performance, and sustainability.

Paradigm leads with prefabricated wall and building systems that surpass industry standards for performance, quality, and durability. Buildforth brings these designs to life through safe, efficient, and timely on-site construction. StokedLiving drives community development through zoning, planning, design, sales, and the homeowner experience, while Paradigm Solar powers our homes to true net-zero with advanced solar and battery integration, enhancing energy independence and long-term resilience.

Paradigm manufactures both open-wall systems for developers and closed-wall panels for turnkey homes using advanced robotic automation to ensure precision, sustainability, and performance. United under PGC, we are shaping the future of housing through craftsmanship, innovation, and a commitment to resilient communities.

We are proud of our strong reputation in the infrastructure and construction sector—and equally proud of the culture we have built. Our team members are valued, supported and empowered to grow.

What we offer

A supportive and professional environment that encourages development and leadership
Exposure to a diverse range of projects, sectors, clients and delivery environments
Clear pathways for career progression and ongoing professional development
A base salary of $140,000–$160,000 plus generous project uplifts, plus superannuation - commensurate with experience
Performance-based bonuses available after six months

Additional benefits designed to enhance your wellbeing and quality of life

If you are seeking a role where your skills will be recognised, challenged and developed - within a firm that values expertise, accountability, active participation and practical problem-solving - we would love to hear from you.

Your Role

Lidiar Group is seeking an experienced Consultant – Project Manager (Civil) to join our growing team.

This role is suited to a degree-qualified Civil Engineer who has progressed beyond purely technical engineering responsibilities and developed strong capability in project management, construction delivery, resource coordination, commercial management and client engagement.

As a Consultant Project Manager, you will provide project management and delivery expertise across the full project lifecycle - from project development and planning through procurement, mobilisation, execution, completion and handover.

Our portfolio spans multiple sectors, with assignments undertaken on both the client and contractor side. Our work ranges from discrete consulting and advisory engagements through to embedded roles where our consultants work directly within client and project teams.

You will apply your civil engineering and project management experience across:
Project planning, mobilisation and execution
Civil construction and infrastructure delivery
Large-scale earthworks and site development
Water and wastewater infrastructure
Transport infrastructure
Building and associated civil works
Resource planning and workforce coordination
Contractor and subcontractor management
Programme, cost and commercial management
Quality management and assurance
Procurement and contract management
Project risk and opportunity management
Stakeholder and client management
Project reporting, governance and performance management
Completion, commissioning and project close-out

This is a hands-on project management and consulting role.

We are looking for someone who can take ownership of a project or significant workstream, establish what needs to be done, coordinate the people and resources required to deliver it, manage competing priorities and maintain control of programme, cost, quality, risk and stakeholder expectations.

You will be expected to combine sound technical understanding with strong project management judgement. You should be comfortable moving between construction and engineering issues, programme and resource constraints, commercial considerations and client requirements while maintaining focus on successful project outcomes.

Typical Assignments

Project Development / Planning
Establishing project scope, objectives, deliverables and execution strategies
Development and review of project management and execution plans
Constructability reviews and input into design development
Development of project programmes, staging and delivery strategies
Resource planning and workforce forecasting
Development of procurement and contracting strategies
Preparation and review of scopes of work and work packages
Contractor and supplier procurement and tender evaluation
Establishment of project budgets, cost controls and reporting frameworks
Identification and management of project, construction and commercial risks
Stakeholder identification, engagement planning and interface management

Project Execution
Management and coordination of civil construction activities
Leadership and coordination of project teams, site personnel and external resources
Management of contractors, subcontractors, suppliers and consultants
Planning and coordination of workforce, plant, equipment and construction resources
Monitoring project progress against programme, budget and delivery objectives
Management of project costs, commitments, forecasts and commercial performance
Coordination of engineering, procurement and construction interfaces
Implementation and oversight of project quality management systems
Management of inspections, testing, non-conformances and corrective actions
Identification and management of project risks, constraints and emerging issues
Management of variations, changes and commercial impacts
Preparation and review of project reports, forecasts and performance information
Direct engagement with clients, contractors, authorities and project stakeholders

Completion / Commissioning
Development and management of completion and handover strategies
Coordination of commissioning and project readiness activities
Management of defects, punch lists and outstanding works
Coordination and close-out of quality records and handover documentation
Commercial and contractual close-out of project packages
Management of final project reporting and completion requirements
Contribution to lessons learned and continuous improvement initiatives

Advisory / Client-Side Assignments
Acting as the client’s representative within integrated project teams
Providing project management and delivery advice
Reviewing contractor programmes, delivery strategies and project performance
Undertaking project health checks, assurance reviews and delivery assessments
Supporting procurement, contractor selection and contract administration
Reviewing project risks, forecasts and recovery strategies
Establishing project governance, reporting and control frameworks
Supporting clients through complex delivery and stakeholder issues
Providing independent advice and recommendations to project leadership teams

Our Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate will be a degree-qualified Civil Engineer with postgraduate qualifications in Project Management and demonstrated experience delivering civil and infrastructure projects within the Australian construction or infrastructure environment.

You will have progressed beyond a predominantly technical engineering role and developed strong capability across project delivery, people and resource management, commercial management, quality and stakeholder engagement.

Experience across several civil infrastructure environments will be highly regarded, particularly:
Large-scale earthworks and bulk civil works
Water and wastewater infrastructure
Transport infrastructure
Building projects and associated civil works

You will ideally demonstrate:
A recognised Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering
Postgraduate qualifications in Project Management (PMP or similar)
Strong project and construction management experience
Demonstrated experience coordinating multidisciplinary project teams and construction workforces
Strong resource management capability, including workforce, subcontractor, plant and project resource coordination
An understanding of project commercials, including budgets, forecasting, procurement, variations and cost control
Strong quality management and quality assurance capability
Experience developing and implementing project plans, programmes and delivery strategies
An ability to identify, assess and proactively manage project risks
Strong written communication and project reporting capability
Mature stakeholder management and interpersonal skills
Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain strong client relationships
Confidence communicating with senior client representatives, contractors, consultants and project teams
An ability to work independently, exercise sound judgement and take ownership of project outcomes

Experience working within a consulting environment will be highly regarded but is not essential. More important is your ability to adapt quickly, understand the needs of different clients and apply your project management experience effectively across different projects and delivery environments.

The Consultant We Are Looking For

Technical and project management capability is only part of this role.

As a Lidiar Group consultant, you will represent our business directly with our clients. We are therefore looking for someone with the maturity and interpersonal capability to quickly establish credibility, understand a client’s needs and become a trusted member of their project team.
You should be comfortable working with people at all levels of a project—from site supervisors and construction crews through to engineers, contractors, senior management and client representatives.

You will need to be able to analyse complex project issues, bring structure to challenging delivery environments, communicate clearly and provide practical solutions rather than simply identifying problems.

We are seeking an enthusiastic, engaged and accountable Project Manager who can lead people, coordinate resources, manage project performance and develop strong relationships while maintaining a clear focus on successful delivery.

Develop Your Career as a Consultant

This opportunity is particularly suited to an experienced Project Manager who wants to broaden their career beyond the delivery of projects within a single organisation, contractor or sector.
You will gain exposure to client-side and contractor-side engagements, consulting and advisory assignments, and embedded project roles across a diverse portfolio of infrastructure projects.
Working alongside experienced project, commercial and technical professionals, you will have the opportunity to broaden your sector experience, strengthen your advisory capability and develop deeper client relationships.

For the right person, the role provides a clear pathway toward more senior positions in Project Management, Project Consulting, Advisory and leadership within Lidiar Group.

Practical Requirements

The role is based in Brisbane and operates within Lidiar Group’s flexible and hybrid working arrangements.

Depending on assignments, there will be requirements to work from client offices and project sites and to undertake project-related travel. At times this may be on project rosters for the duration of projects - uplifts are applied to salary to compensate for this.

Candidates must hold appropriate Australian working rights and be able to work effectively within client, office and construction site environments.

Salary
Base salary: $140,000–$160,000 plus generous project uplifts, plus superannuation - commensurate with experience.

The successful candidate will also be eligible to participate in Lidiar Group’s performance incentive program after six months.

If you are an experienced Civil Engineer and Project Manager who enjoys taking ownership, leading people, solving complex delivery problems and working directly with clients, we encourage you to apply.

The ATM Program Manager will direct the end-to-end strategy, security, and operational health of our organization's ATM fleet. In this role, you will bridge high-level business planning with day-to-day execution to deliver a seamless, secure, and highly reliable banking experience for our members.
Proactive, hands-on leader who identifies issues early, responds to service disruptions with urgency, drives problems through resolution, holds vendors accountable, and uses reporting and analytics to continuously improve ATM service and the member experience.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

ATM program lifecycle management including planning, procurement, deployment, installation, operations, maintenance, upgrades, refurbishments, and decommissioning/disposal.
Develop comprehensive budget plans that align with the strategic goals of the ATM network.
Own the health and day-to-day performance of the ATM fleet, including uptime, connectivity, hardware/software performance, and transaction processing.
Analyze ATM utilization, transaction trends, service costs, and performance to recommend improvements, relocations, replacements, consolidations, or new capabilities.
Proactively monitor fleet conditions and ensure outages, degraded service, recurring failures, and other service-impacting issues are identified, escalated, and resolved with urgency.
Drive root-cause analysis and permanent corrective action for significant or recurring ATM problems; ensure issues are followed through to complete resolution.
Manage ATM vendors and service providers, including maintenance, processing, telecommunications, and other third parties; monitor and enforce SLA performance.
Serve as key encryption administrator to ensure the organization's cryptographic keys are securely managed to industry standards.
Partner with Information Security, Fraud, Risk, Compliance, Audit, and Physical Security to maintain appropriate ATM controls and address security, regulatory, and fraud-related issues.
Provide timely communication to management and impacted stakeholders during ATM incidents, including impact, actions underway, expected resolution, and root cause.
Manage ATM-related financial activities, including reviewing and validating invoices for accuracy, resolving billing discrepancies, and monitoring costs against contractual terms.
Maintain a working understanding of ATM physical infrastructure and construction requirements, including surrounds, site layouts, and installation considerations, to effectively plan ATM relocations, replacements, and new installations.
Accountable for producing and presenting a recurring ATM Fleet Health Report that gives management clear visibility into fleet performance, risks, trends, and required actions. Reporting should include: Fleet and individual ATM uptime/availability
Outage frequency, duration, and mean time to restore service
Chronic or repeat-problem ATMs and corrective actions
Transaction volume, utilization, and usage trends
Failed/declined transaction trends
Vendor SLA, response, and resolution performance
Operating/maintenance costs and lifecycle status
Significant incidents, security/fraud events, risks, and management actions
The Program Manager is expected to provide analysis and recommendations and clearly identify areas requiring management attention or corrective action.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
3-5 years of experience in ATM operations, electronic banking, payments, banking operations, technology operations, or a related field.
Working knowledge of ATM hardware/software, transaction processing, communications, invoice reconciliation, and vendor support models.
Demonstrated experience with operational metrics, dashboards, trend analysis, vendor/SLA management, and root-cause problem solving.
Strong ownership, urgency, analytical ability, communication skills, and ability to manage multiple operational priorities and vendors.
Disciplined lifecycle planning and continuous improvement.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Idaho National Laboratory is hiring a Energy Research and Development Program Manager to work on our Energy and Environment, Science and Technology (EEST) team. Our team works a 9x80 schedule located out of our Idaho Falls facility with every other Friday off.

Essential Job Functions And Responsibilities

Oversee multiple ongoing, rapidly expanding projects, some of which are managed by subordinate Project Managers.
Track project deliverables using appropriate tools. Ensure proper planning and scheduling for operational-related activities to support timely and successful completion of program/project work. Implement and manage project changes and interventions to achieve successful project outputs.
Proactively manage and execute sets of projects into programs on schedule and within assigned budgets. Act as appropriate to correct deviations from schedule and budget. Provide recommendations to project management to allow timely resolution of problems and issues. Use appropriate conflict resolution skills to manage competing stakeholder interests.
Direct or support engineering projects related to upgrading facilities, constructing new facilities to include planning, budgeting, procuring, and managing projects.
Aid in developing research, engineering, and operations teams to help partners meet their goals.
Interface with partners (DOE, DOD, and others) and coordinate among INL operations, research, and business organizations to support programs in the area of specialty.
Prepare or direct the preparation of progress and special reports to customer and management.
Ensure that laboratory requirements and standards for the management of projects are met and are consistently applied in the acceptance and integration of work. Integrate managed scope with ongoing and evolving mission needs.
Ensure that all customer contact, including major correspondence and work relationships between management and the customer, is maintained throughout the duration of the program. Conduct periodic project and customer meetings to review progress and discuss issues. Ensure problems involving coordination, schedule, and the setting of priorities are resolved by the project teams. Obtain the customer's acceptance of the work and document all turnover activities. Responsible for the preparation and submission of the final project reports and prompt close-out of the projects supporting the program.
Identify new opportunities and support growth in a dynamic and necessarily agile security R&D business environment. Match INL unique capabilities with capability gaps and needs of clients. Advise on emerging capabilities.
Analyze data to understand organizational disparities and implement solutions to address the identified disparity. Combine data analysis with experience/knowledge to deliver reliable and executable solutions.
Develop teams as appropriate to successfully complete projects.
Coach other managers, support succession planning, and actively develop future leaders at INL

jobs.description:
Description

AWS Developer Experience is looking for a Program Manager to own end-to-end operations, reporting, and the global expansion playbook for the AWS Builder Loft program. Builder Lofts are physical developer community spaces where builders come together for hands-on workshops, hackathons, technical talks, mentorship, and networking. This role is critical for ensuring the Builder Loft operates with operational excellence and scales repeatably as we expand to new cities worldwide.

You will be the operational backbone of the program - managing event calendaring, budgeting, resource allocation, tooling, and process documentation. You will prepare and deliver Business Reviews with operational metrics, own budget management, and develop the standardized playbooks and mechanisms that enable the Lofts to be a sustainable operation. This is a high-impact role that requires someone who combines deep program management expertise with a builder mindset. You think in systems, design for scale, and drive continuous improvement through data. You will work cross-functionally with community management, engineering teams, product, event technology, marketing, and vendors to ensure seamless alignment and execution.

* * *

Key job responsibilities

Manage end-to-end program operations: event calendaring, budgeting, and process documentation
Prepare and deliver reports with operational metrics, attendance data, CSAT scores, and budget tracking
Produce quarterly newsletters and stakeholder updates summarizing Loft performance and upcoming programming
Manage operational tooling (marketing automation tools configuration, project management, and other platforms driving continuous improvement
Standardize operating procedures, staffing models, launch checklists, and operational standards
Coordinate cross-functionally with technical teams, creative teams, event technology, community management, and marketing to ensure alignment
Own budget management and financial reporting for the Loft program
Own feedback mechanisms such as CSAT surveys, research, customer forums and similiar
Manage and oversee program operations support channels via Slack and email
Oversee efficient staffing by vendors, manage contracts and invoicing
Create content for our main developer engagement channels such as builder.aws.com

About The Team

jobs.title: IT Program Manager
jobs.description:
CECO Environmental is a global leader in providing sustainable solutions for industrial air, water, and energy transition. Since 1966, we’ve been addressing the world’s most pressing environmental challenges. Our mission is to protect people, the environment, and industrial equipment, making a tangible impact across industries like renewable energy, semiconductor manufacturing, power generation, and water treatment. As a purpose-driven company, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and integrity, ensuring that every project we undertake creates lasting positive change. At CECO, you’ll be part of a growing, dynamic team committed to a cleaner, safer, and more sustainable future.

We are proud to share that CECO was named one of Newsweek’s America’s Greatest Companies for 2025 and that Forbes recognized CECO as one of America’s Most Successful Small Cap Companies for 2026, marking our third consecutive year on the Forbes list. CECO Environmental is a publicly traded company on the NASDAQ under the ticker CECO, reflecting our strong growth, financial performance, and commitment to delivering value to shareholders.

The IT Program Manager will be responsible for IT Program Management for Business Enterprise Applications. This includes Dynamics 365 F&O and CE. In this role, you will be responsible for working with the ERP Teams to set and develop current workload and standards. You will plan for D365 Migrations from legacy ERP systems and D365 Enhancements. Another key responsibility is to oversee and ensure key milestones are met for each delivery. You will work and build the enterprise Business Applications roadmap. You will have active oversight to the work of multiple project managers. This role will report into the CECO IT PMO.

Specifically, the role owns two parallel mandates: planning and executing the migration from our current ERP to Dynamics 365 F&O and managing and planning for the D365 enhancement backlog. The scope of program management will also include the same activities for Microsoft Dynamics CRM— including continuous roadmap planning and prioritization.

You will operate under minimal supervision as a trusted member of the ERP program, working comfortably in an environment where requirements evolve and answers are not always predefined. Success requires a methodology mindset with flexibility and delivery focus. Someone who values structured, repeatable practices without letting process impede delivery.

This role will be onsite in Addison, TX.

Your Responsibilities Will Be

Corporate Business Applications Program Roadmap and Planning. You will partner the ERP system architecture leads to outline timing, approach and scope.
Develop and own integrated program plans, budgets, resource plans, risk registers, and status reporting for executive stakeholders.
The Program Manager will have accountability for the work performed by the project managers assigned to the migrations.
Each application migration or new system implementation will be subject to audit – both internal and external. As such, the Program Manager will be held accountable for adherence to “New System Implementation” controls.
Direct functional and technical workstreams (solution architects, consultants, developers, business analysts) across Finance, Supply Chain, and Operations modules, ensuring alignment with business process owners.
Manage third-party implementation partners and vendor engagements, including SOW scope control and quality assurance. Candidates must be comfortable with solving complex problems and understand how and when to escalate resource delivery issues.
Drive organizational change management, user training, and adoption so the business realizes value from day one.
The IT Program Manager will be exposed to M&A Integration activities. This includes working with acquired business workstreams to migrate acquired business applications, mainly focused on ERP migrations. The M&A Integration work will include fast paced business interactions to ensure alignment and coordination with business objectives while leading and communicating through change associated with M&A Integration activities, all while minimizing disruption to business operations.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree required (Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field); Master’s degree a plus.
PMP, PgMP, Agile (SAFe/PSM) certifications a plus.
Microsoft Dynamics 365.
Experience in manufacturing, distribution, professional services industry with SOX hands on experience.
Background in both program-level governance and hands-on problem-solving (stepping into a workstream to unblock critical issues).
Experience managing budgets of and vendor/SI relationships.

jobs.description:
The Regional Program Manager (RPM) owns delivery of the ERTS Commercial Compliance Program within an assigned multi-state region. This is a working manager role: the RPM performs client compliance inspections, audits, hazard assessments, and on-site EH&S training while also managing the regional book of business, client relationships, scheduling, subcontractors, and quality of deliverables. The RPM is the primary technical and commercial point of contact for program clients in the region.

The program spans OSHA, EPA, and DOT HMT requirements, plus the state programs that apply in the region. The ideal candidate has a consulting or multi-site practitioner background, is comfortable in a client facing environment, and can translate regulatory findings into practical corrective actions and sellable follow up work.

Clean Harbors is the leading provider of environmental, energy and industrial services throughout the United States, Canada, Mexico and Puerto Rico. Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. We are solving tough problems through innovation and proven methodology – come be part of the solution with us.

This position is located and supports the Central Region of the US.

Why work for Clean Harbors?

Health and Safety is our #1 priority and we live it 3-6-5!
Focus on maintaining sustainability and cleaning the Earth
Recruiting Pay range of $110,000-$120,000
Comprehensive health benefits coverage after 30 days of full-time employment including 401K with Company match
Own part of the company with our Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Opportunities for growth and development for all the stages of your career
Company paid training and tuition reimbursement

Responsibilities

Program and Client Management

Manage all Commercial Compliance Program accounts in the region: onboarding, annual service calendars, scheduling of site visits, and delivery of services.
Serve as the single point of contact for regional clients; conduct kickoff and close meetings, present findings to leadership, and manage escalations.
Track utilization, billable hours, and deliverable status; maintain accurate client records, inspection reports, training rosters, and corrective action logs.
Coordinate and quality-check subcontractors for specialty scopes.
Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities and hand off or close in coordination with sales.

Compliance Services

Perform on-site compliance audits and gap analyses against regulatory requirements and best practices.
Conduct hazard assessments including PPE hazard assessments, job hazard analyses, and facility walkthroughs; document findings with regulatory citations, risk ranking, and recommended corrective actions.
Review client hazardous waste program and storage areas: generator category determinations and episodic generation, waste determinations, accumulation area inspections, contingency plan reviews, biennial reports, manifest recordkeeping
Deliver monthly inspection program tools and safety communications ('safety splashes') to program clients.
Support clients during agency inspections and in responding to OSHA citations, EPA or state notices of violation, and consent orders.

Training Delivery

Develop and deliver on-site and virtual EH&S training, including OSHA HAZWOPER and general industry topics, RCRA Hazardous Waste, DOT Hazardous Materials.
Assist clients with maintain training records to satisfy regulatory documentation requirements and support client audit defense.

Regional Regulatory Awareness

Maintain working knowledge of state-plan OSHA programs and state-authorized RCRA programs in the assigned region and advise clients where state requirements are more stringent than federal.
Monitor regulatory changes affecting program clients and brief the Director and client contacts.

Qualifications

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in occupational safety and health, Environmental Science, Industrial Hygiene, Engineering, Chemistry, or a closely related technical field.

Experience

Seven to ten years of progressive EHS experience, including at least three years performing compliance audits or inspections across multiple sites or multiple clients.
Demonstrated hands-on experience with both general industry safety programs (29 CFR 1910) and RCRA hazardous waste generator compliance (40 CFR Parts 260 to 262).
Experience delivering EHS training to hourly and supervisory audiences.
Experience in an environmental or EHS consulting firm, or in a multi-site corporate EHS role with external client or vendor-facing responsibility.

Required Credentials, Training, And Conditions

Valid driver's license and acceptable motor vehicle record; ability to travel 50 to 70 percent, including overnight.
40-Hour HAZWOPER
RCRA training
DOT hazmat employee training
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and web-based EHS data platforms; ability to write clear, citation-supported technical reports.

Preferred Qualifications

Board certification. One or more board certifications: Certified Safety Professional (CSP) or Associate Safety Professional (ASP) from BCSP; Certified Hazardous Materials Manager (CHMM) from IHMM; Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH) from BGC; or OHST/CHST from BCSP.
Management systems. ISO 14001 / ISO 45001 lead auditor or internal auditor training; experience with EHS management system audits.
Adjacent programs. Experience with SPCC plans, Tier II reporting, & stormwater (NPDES MSGP).
Advanced degree. Master's degree in related discipline.
Leadership and commercial. Prior experience managing or mentoring field EHS staff; experience scoping and pricing consultation work.

Physical Requirements And Working Conditions

Frequent walking and standing on industrial sites, including outdoor areas, shop floors, loading docks, and container storage areas; ability to climb stairs and ladders and lift up to 40 pounds.
Wear required PPE including safety-toe footwear, eye and hearing protection, and respirators as required.
Extended regional driving and periodic air travel; home office when not in the field.

Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. As part of this vision, we’re investing heavily in building scalable, science-friendly infrastructure to accelerate the pace of innovation in machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI). We’re seeking a Principal Engineer to lead the technical direction of our next-generation Recommender Systems (RecSys) platforms — systems that sit at the core of how customers experience Prime Video.

About The Team

Our mission is to automate and enhance customer engagement through personalization, using ML and Generative AI.

Your work will shape how millions of customers discover content they love, optimizing for engagement, retention, and long-term customer value.

Your technical leadership will shape the future of AI/ML across Prime Video, unlocking generative and ML models that personalize content for hundreds of millions of viewers worldwide.

Description

Amazon Robotics (AR) seeks a talented and motivated Sr. Technical Program Manager (TPM) to join the Quality Technology Services (QTS) organization, focused on manufacturing technology platforms. This role owns the program management and delivery of manufacturing execution systems and shop-floor technology solutions including Tulip (MES platform), Atlas tools, and associated integrations that enable Amazon Robotics' production operations at scale.

The TPM will lead programs that connect manufacturing operations with technology platforms, driving capability build-out, system implementations, and continuous improvement across Tulip MES, Atlas tools (work instructions, traceability, quality inspection, production dashboards), and their integrations with enterprise systems (ERP, PLM, and supply chain platforms). This is a high-visibility role requiring strong manufacturing domain expertise, technical program management rigor, and the ability to partner with plant operations, manufacturing engineering, quality, and software teams to deliver solutions that improve throughput, quality, and operator experience on the shop floor.

The ideal candidate brings a passion for manufacturing technology transformation, hands-on experience with MES platforms and shop-floor digitization, and the leadership skills to drive cross-functional alignment between manufacturing operations, IT, quality engineering, and partner technology teams within QTS.

As a Senior Program Manager, you will be expected to execute development programs of significant size and complexity. This involves achieving scope, schedule, cost, delivery, and quality requirements while showcasing mastery in program management skills. A thorough understanding of various workstreams, including functions and Centers of Excellence (COEs), is essential for this role. Responsibilities

Generate, implement program plans and business requirements within approved budget and schedule constraints
Define and implement the program-level Management Operating System (MOS)

Scheduling, including resource-loading and critical path analysis

Coordinate with Customer Business Teams and/or GBE to ensure their application programs are supported for technical performance, schedule, and cost requirements

Establish and maintain the channels of communication to assure timely management awareness of program progress and issues
Present programmatic details, requirements, actions status to leadership, technical, and functional audiences

YOU MUST HAVE

8+ years’ relevant program or project management experience and expertise within technical or business field
Knowledge of project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall) and associated tools
Strong leadership, executive-level communication, and people management skills
Excellent strategic thinking and problem-solving skills

WE VALUE

Strong Business and Financial Acumen
Ability to clearly, precisely communicate with stakeholders, team members, and customers
Ability to coach, guide, motivate teams, and foster collaboration
Ability to resolve disputes and reach agreements among stakeholders with conflicting interests
Ability to make sound and timely judgments in ambiguous environment.
Ability to adjust plans and strategies to meet changing project requirements or shifting priorities
Knowledge of the Aerospace industry and/or engines and power systems business
BS/BA/Master’s degree in Engineering or Business
Knowledge of requirements Management and Fulfillment; Planning / Estimation, including resource, material, capital, and other needs
High bias for action and integrative thinking skills.
Recognized leader for willingness to champion change in a rapidly evolving environment.
Proven excellence in effective communication, interactive and presentation skills
Ability to integrate complex concepts and information with program management systems and processes
Proven track record of establishing procedures, best practices, and associated compliance
PMP or other relevant industry-standard certifications

Benefits

Beyond a performance-driven salary, you'll work alongside dedicated experts on technology that's advancing aviation. As a Honeywell Aerospace employee, you're eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision and life insurance

Title

Technical Program Manager

Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR!

KBR’s National Security Solutions team provides high-end engineering and advanced technology solutions to our customers in the intelligence and national security communities. In this position, your work will have a profound impact on the country’s most critical role – protecting our national security.

Why Join Us?

Innovative Projects: KBR’s work is at the forefront of engineering, logistics, operations, science, program management, mission IT and cybersecurity solutions.
Collaborative Environment: Be part of a dynamic team that thrives on collaboration and innovation, fostering a supportive and intellectually stimulating workplace.
Impactful Work: Your contributions will be pivotal in designing and optimizing defense systems that ensure national security and shape the future of space defense.

Position Summary

KBR, Inc. is seeking a highly capable technical program manager to join our team in Dayton, OH (on-site). This role supports the Architecture and Systems Engineering (ASE) Group in the development, implementation, and proliferation of mission system Government Reference Architectures (GRAs). These GRAs provide the backbone for enabling advanced sensor capability for emerging and legacy systems across the Air Force, other component services, and international partners. This position serves as a technical program manager performing cost, schedule, performance, and risk management for various contractual activities conducting open system architecture maturation, model-based systems engineering, software development, and system verification & validation. The ideal candidate would have experience in agile development, stakeholder management, and program management.

Key Responsibilities

Manage: Utilize data-driven techniques to guide an industry/government consortium in the maturation, verification, and implementation of GRAs. Program management duties include balancing program cost and schedule factors to drive successful mission outcomes for the Government customer.
Lead: Leads a multi-disciplinary industry and Government team in developing and executing technical and programmatic strategies focused on delivering superior open system architecture products that meet adopter needs. Utilizes adopter feedback to develop easy-to-use Government Reference Architectures and standards.
Engage: Proactively engage with a diverse stakeholder community to ensure user feedback is rapidly and iteratively incorporated into ASE products. Works with stakeholders to formulate collaborative approaches to deliver successful program outcomes.
Deliver: Process owner supporting Agile development of Government Reference Architectures and standards focused on delivering easy to use products and services supporting multiple customers.
Perform: Support the Government customer in developing tactical execution plans based on high-level strategic guidance. Utilize agile management processes to lead an industry consortium in the execution of those plans.
Gap Analysis & Risk Identification: Based on identified system capability gaps, system requirements, and stakeholder feedback, formulate and implement executable program strategies that deliver high-quality open architecture products. Identify and define suitable risk mitigation plans to address program and/or technical issues.

Work Environment

Location: Onsite
Travel Requirements: 0-10%
Working Hours: Standard – Core hours 0900 - 1500

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor of Science is a technical field.
Active Top Secret clearance.
3+ years in technical execution.
10+ years of technical program management.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to form strong relationships with team members, customers, and other Government partners.
Strong technical proficiency with a willingness/ability to learn about mission system software architectures.
Work with a team of Government and industry SMEs to ensure that programmatic and technical objectives are met.
Ability to own responsibility for deliverables, cost, and schedule.
Ability to manage workload of simultaneous tasking in a fast paced, high-demand environment.
Personality for a consensus building among multiple stakeholders with competing equities.

Desired

10+ years in technical execution in a software-related discipline.
7+ years of Government acquisition program management
3+ years working in Special Access environments
Familiarity with Agile software development, CI/CD pipelines, and practices.
Familiarity with existing DoD open architectures and standards including Agile Mission Suite (AMS), Open Mission Systems (OMS), Universal Command & Control Interface (UCI), or related open architectures.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If you’re excited about making a significant impact in the field of space defense and working on projects that matter, we encourage you to apply and join our team at KBR. Let's shape the future together.

The Weapons Product Definition (E-11) group is looking for a Science/Engineering Program Manager. E-11 provides model-based system engineering, mechanical design engineering, and computer-aided design (CAD) support to the active stockpile weapons systems, hydrodynamic tests, sub-critical experiments, and related qualification efforts.

The successful candidate will provide leadership and overall management of a large E-11 portfolio that is comprised of work performed for multiple programs, including the B61, W76, W78, W88, and W93. The PM is expected to serve as the primary interface between technical leads and program partners, with the ability to help translate mission needs into well-defined requirements, develop funding estimates, and establish and monitor executable schedules. The role requires building trust and consensus across diverse stakeholders, facilitating negotiations, and maintaining proactive, solutions-oriented communication to ensure strong alignment between technical teams and customers.

Working with E-DO, you will also help with developing robust metrics and reporting frameworks that provide leadership with transparent, data-driven insights into program performance., and You will also implement risk identification, tracking, and reporting methodology that enables proactive mitigation and clear communication of projects health.

This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of engineering innovation and strategic program execution, shaping the future of E-11 capabilities.

E-11 Science/Engineering Program Manager key responsibilities:

Gathering status reports across all E-11 projects from FLMs, team leads, projects leads and individual designers and engineers
Serving as an effective liaison on projects' scope/schedule/resources/budget between E-11 personnel and stakeholders
Attending weekly Integrated Schedule meetings
Tracking budgets and work package deliverables throughout the current fiscal year
Working with customers and E-11 staff to develop and finalize work packages for the upcoming fiscal year
Coordinating with the group's budget analyst on a weekly basis to proactively address any budget concerns, update staff forecasts, and maintain a close working relationship
Tracking new design requests and working closely with FLMs to ensure their timely assignments
Assisting with metric data collection and analysis
Assisting with procurement tracking, working closely with vendors, E-11 personnel and programs
Assisting with contract tracking

What You Need

Minimum Job Requirements:

Program Management:

Knowledge and experience in program management including:

Defining program work scope, schedules, budgets, priorities, and performance milestones;
Developing cost, scope and schedule baselines;
Reporting cost and schedule variance; and
Managing change control and risk
The capacity to work independently with minimum supervision, as well as the ability to be an effective member of a multidisciplinary team is expected.

Technical Skills:

Ability to understand technical concepts related to E-11 capabilities and customer requirements within the portfolios you support

Collaboration:

Demonstrated effective oral and written communication skills, e.g. formal / informal publications and reports
Ability to serve as the primary spokesperson for a program, reporting status and proactively informing stakeholders of any issues

Process Improvements:

Demonstrated ability to identify, design, and implement process improvements that increase efficiency, consistency, and program outcomes for internal employees, customers and leaders

Ability to obtain a DOE Q clearance, which usually requires US citizenship

Education and Experience:
Position requires a bachelor's degree in a related field from an accredited institution and 5 years of directly related experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience directly related to the occupation.

Desired Qualifications:

Formal project or program management training or certification (e.g., PMP)
Familiarity with MicroStrategy, CRES, Synthesis, pivot tables
Experience supporting DOE/NNSA programs or interacting with federal stakeholders
Active DOE or DoD Security Clearance
Active Sigma-15
Demonstrated initiative in identifying and implementing business process improvements.

Work Location:
The work location for this position is onsite and located in Los Alamos, NM. All work locations are at the discretion of management.

Position commitment:

Regular appointment employees are required to serve a period of continuous service in their current position in order to be eligible to apply for posted jobs throughout the Laboratory. If an employee has not served the time required, they may only apply for Laboratory jobs with the documented approval of their Division Leader. The position commitment for this position is 1 year.

Note to Applicants:

Along with your resume, please include a detailed cover letter explaining how you meet each of the minimum requirements and any of the desired qualifications

Due to federal restrictions contained in the current National Defense Authorization Act, citizens of the People's Republic of China-including the special administrative regions of Hong Kong and Macau-as well as citizens of the Islamic Republic of Iran, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (North Korea), and the Russian Federation, who are not Lawful Permanent Residents ("green card" holders) are prohibited from accessing facilities that support the mission, functions, and operations of national security laboratories and nuclear weapons production facilities, which includes Los Alamos National Laboratory.

Where You Will Work

Located in beautiful northern New Mexico, Los Alamos National Laboratory (LANL) is a multidisciplinary research institution engaged in strategic science on behalf of national security. Our generous benefits package includes:

PPO or High Deductible medical insurance with the same large nationwide network
Dental and vision insurance
Free basic life and disability insurance
Paid childbirth and parental leave
Award-winning 401(k) (6% matching plus 3.5% annually)
Learning opportunities and tuition assistance
Flexible schedules and time off (PTO and holidays)
Onsite gyms and wellness programs
Extensive relocation packages (outside a 50 mile radius)

Additional Details

Dependent upon the position, additional authorization to access classified information may be required, which may or may not be available to dual citizens. Receipt of a Q clearance and additional access authorization ultimately is a decision of the Federal Government and not of Triad.

Eligibility requirements: To obtain a clearance, an individual must be at least 18 years of age; U.S. citizenship is required except in very limited circumstances. See DOE Order 472.2 for additional information.
