jobs.description:
Description

Seeking a career with a sense of purpose, work life balance, and growth opportunities? There’s a place for you at Leidos! At Leidos, we are committed to making the world safer, healthier, and more efficient through technology, engineering, and science. You would be a valued member of global team providing services across the Digital Sector. At Leidos, team member career development, flexibility, and well-being are priority and is supported by consistent leadership engagement, an experienced human relations staff, and numerous employee support programs.

Use your unique talents and make an immediate impact…

The Mission Operations Area within Leidos’ Digital Sector is seeking an experienced Senior Program Manager
to manage the Compartmented Enterprise Services Office (CESO) Task Order for the Systems Engineering, Technology, and Innovation (SETI) contract. This individual should be a self-motivated professional with experience leading high performing enterprise operations teams in a high op-temp, top secret environment. The individual should have excellent communication, critical thinking, and collaboration skills to function in a high-paced, dynamic environment supporting the most senior levels of national security decision-making. The PM will need to be capable of leading all facets of this task to success.

Within the CESO program, the Defense Information System Agency (DISA) is looking to ensure highly reliable delivery of critical secure information capabilities in support of senior DoD and IC community leaders. As part of this task order, Leidos manages the operations and sustainment of the cloud and broader information environment to include operational engineering, support to the continuous development & continuous integration environment, fourth estate consolidation, and broad professional services – ITIL/DevSecOps based processes, excellent customer experience 1st call resolution, and service catalog-based delivery for Defense Working Capital Fund (DWCF) Model.

Primary Responsibilities

Ensure sustained operations of CESO mission capabilities driving delivery of operational best practices across CESO
Ensured delivery of commitments made to DISA and mission partners to ensure high availability and reliability of CESO operations
Deliver exceptional service to DISA by leading the team delivering a range of services
Communicate critical and time sensitive program-related information directly to the SETI Leadership, or other delegated Government program personnel
Perform as key point of contact for client relations and engage regularly to determine priorities based on the Customer guidance
Engage with other SETI Task Order Managers to achieve synergy and efficiency
Delivery of all programmatic components (cost, schedule, performance) to drive execution of the task orders
Financial performance (revenue, operating income, margin) against the Annual Operating Plan commitments made.

Basic Qualifications

Candidate must possess an active DOD TS/SCI
BS/BS or equivalent experience and 12+ years of prior relevant experience or Masters with 8+ years of prior relevant experience. Add'l experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
Proven experience leading operational teams to ensure mission availability and reliability
Ability to obtain an AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner within 120 days of starting
4+ years of experience supervising or leading technical teams or projects.
Experience shall include regular communications with the supported organization’s senior leadership and direct accountability for managed activities.
Proven ability to connect with and effectively lead a high performing diverse team of varying levels of experience.
Previous experience with supporting / leading proposals to achieve on-contract growth.
Experience leading programs with year over year financial growth and strong margin growth.
Excellent written and oral communication capability
Experience and ability to successfully negotiate and influence others to understand and accept new concepts, practices and approaches.
Ability to drive employee culture change and transformation.
Experience leading teams in a high op-temp, top secret environment

Preferred Qualifications

PMP Certification
Prior experienced with DISA and DISA’s support to mission partners

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

Original Posting

September 28, 2026

For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.

Pay Range

Pay Range $154,050.00 - $278,475.00

The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.

About Leidos

Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, with 47,000 global employees, Leidos reported annual revenues of approximately $16.7 billion for the fiscal year ended January 3, 2025. For more information, visit www.Leidos.com.

Pay And Benefits

Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www.leidos.com/careers/pay-benefits.

Securing Your Data

Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos’ name. Leidos will never ask you to provide payment-related information during any part of the employment application process (i.e., ask you for money), nor will Leidos ever advance money as part of the hiring process (i.e., send you a check or money order before doing any work). Further, Leidos will only communicate with you through emails that are generated by the Leidos.com automated system – never from free commercial services (e.g., Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail) or via WhatsApp, Telegram, etc. If you received an email purporting to be from Leidos that asks for payment-related information or any other personal information (e.g., about you or your previous employer), and you are concerned about its legitimacy, please make us aware immediately by emailing us at LeidosCareersFraud@leidos.com.

If you believe you are the victim of a scam, contact your local law enforcement and report the incident to the U.S. Federal Trade Commission.

Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law. Leidos will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with relevant laws.

Job Description

Location: Two Snowhill - Birmingham

Salary Base salary: c£79,035pa to £92,982pa depending on skills and experience. In addition, we offer flexible benefits fund of 20% which is paid on top base salary and is fully pensionable, as well as a range of competitive benefits - check them out in the Benefits section on our website.

HS2 Ltd endeavours to ensure everyone working for us and with us feels included, thrives, and achieves their full potential. In practice, this means we are positive and inclusive about making adjustments, providing flexible working, encouraging our staff networks to flourish, and providing personal and professional development opportunities.

As a Senior Project Manager
at HS2 you will be responsible for leading multidisciplinary teams to manage the resolution of cross-programme risks and issues, coordinating diverse teams to develop integrated solutions for formal governance approvals, interface with external stakeholders whilst working collaboratively with internal delivery and functional teams. This role will work collaboratively with the Supply Chain to enable the efficient delivery of Washwood Heath to budget, time and quality and support the successful delivery of the whole HS2 railway into passenger service.

About The Role

To be responsible for supporting the Washwood Heath Area Director to deliver integration capability for Washwood Heath, working closely with the Construction JV, Programme Integration Unit, functional and stakeholder structures and delivering in line with HS2’s integration behaviours and ways of working.
To be embedded within the Washwood Heath area and supporting the Director to effectively and efficiently manage integration risks and issues.
To be responsible for leading a team of Project Managers.
To be responsible for enabling, taking, and recommending best for programme decisions, to ensure successful delivery of the whole Systems programme.
To be responsible for managing and working with a wide range of internal (to HS2) and external stakeholders to identify and resolve integration challenges. These will range from the Civils Integration Unit, Systems Delivery Integration Unit, Operations and Maintenance, matrix functions such as the PMO, Commercial, Engineering and IM, Main Contractors and Designers, through to external stakeholders such as DfT, ORR, HSE, Fire Authorities, Utilities Companies, Network Rail and TfL
To be responsible for horizon scanning for integration risks and opportunities and escalating to the Programme Integration Unit so that Phase level contingency is allocated appropriately and presents value for money.
To support the planning and execution of Systems Handovers and Transitions ultimately supporting the delivery of an integrated HS2 Railway into passenger service.
To be responsible for reviewing and challenging programme schedules, looking at cross-HS2 dependencies to optimise delivery.
To be responsible for supporting a collaborative culture which enables high performance by encouraging innovation and knowledge sharing between HS2 as the client, other Integrated Project Teams, and the supply chain.

Actively promote and embed Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion (EDI) in all your work and support and comply with all organisational initiatives, policies, and procedures on EDI.

Skills

About You:

Project Management – the ability to develop, plan and integrate projects to optimise target costs, dependencies, risk management, and project benefits. Skills profile aligned to APM Project Manager (advanced).
Problem Solving – the ability to identify integration problems and review related information in order to manage the development and evaluation of options and implementation of solutions, including the ability to manage and plan multiple workstreams and consider the competing demands of stakeholders, cost, time, and quality.
Decision Making – the ability to identify, manage, gather and synthesise the necessary information and facilitate the identification of options and the application of judgement based on logic and reason Analysis - the ability to analyse inputs, assess data in order to assist in the development of strategies and document supporting rationales.
Influencing & Negotiating – the ability to influence and negotiate with internal functions and external supply chain partners.
Building Relationships – Ability to establish and maintain relationships with internal and external stakeholders and suppliers to resolve emergent risk situations.

Knowledge

Understanding of the project management knowledge aligned to the level of APM Project Manager (advanced)
Understanding of the technical elements and architecture of the relevant scope of work within the overall HS2 programme, including interdependencies.
Understanding of the nature of the relevant contract structures and the design and application of appropriate contract and supplier performance systems.
Understanding of risk identification and management
Understanding of project schedule management, dependencies, and risk assessment

Types of Experience

Experience of the entire project lifecycle including planning, procuring, developing, and implementing project activities.
Experience of testing and commissioning across complex technical integration projects.
Experience of handing over operational assets to the end-user and the suite of requirements
Experience of leading, managing people and working across functions and disciplines to deliver complex objectives.
Degree level qualification in project management, engineering, commercial management, or the equivalent experience.

The post-holder is expected to behave at all times in a manner consistent with the HS2 values of Safety, Leadership, Integrity, and Respect

It is expected that you will actively promote and embed Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion (EDI) in all your work and support and comply with all organisational initiatives, policies, and procedures on EDI.

As HS2 Ltd do not hold a sponsorship license from the Home Office, we are not able to provide sponsorship to any applicant. Applicants must already have the Right to Work in the UK at the time of application and our process involves a Right to Work validation prior to the interview stage. Note, there are certain types of time-bound visas that we cannot accept.

Any offers made to applicants will be subject to satisfactory completion of pre-employment checks which include Nationality & Immigration Status, employment references, DBS, Financial and Education checks.

We ask for a variety of detail in your online application; however, we perform the first assessment of suitability for a role based solely on the information in your CV. In a further development of our efforts to create a more diverse workforce, your CV will be anonymised, and personal information will be removed during the first stage of the application review. This removes bias from the process and makes it even more important that you attach an updated word version of your CV for each new application ensuring you include evidence directly related to the criteria in the job advert.

Any applications received after the closing date will not be considered.

About Us

High Speed 2 (HS2 Ltd) will be the UK’s new high speed rail network. As well as improving capacity, the new scheme will shorten journey times between a number of Britain’s major population centres, boost the economy and create thousands of jobs.

HS2 Ltd will create a skills legacy and develop a diverse range of talent. We aim to be a leader in EDI practice by creating a safe & inclusive working environment for all our staff - living our values of Safety, Respect, Integrity and Leadership.

In practice, this means we are positive and inclusive about making adjustments, providing flexible working, encouraging our staff networks to flourish and providing personal and professional development opportunities.

HS2 Ltd is also a safety-critical organisation. Employees are required to ensure reasonable care of their own and others’ health and safety by taking personal responsibility for working to our ‘Safe at Heart’ programme principles and following safe working procedures at all times.

HS2 Ltd endeavours to ensure everyone working for us and with us feels included, thrives and achieves their full potential.

jobs.title: Aviation Security Manager , North America Aviation Security
jobs.description:
Description

The Amazon Aviation Security (AvSec) team is seeking an enthusiastic AvSec Manager to provide leadership, and oversight for Amazon Air’s (AIR) cargo transportation business. The AvSec Manager will be responsible for defining and driving new initiatives for the transportation supply chain involving Amazon owned and third-party (3P) delivery methods. This includes independently determining risk-based security standards, exercising discretion in interpreting and applying airport and federal regulations, and making decisions regarding compliance approaches and standardized processes. The AvSec Manager serves as the interface between AIR and AvSec leadership, and will be responsible for exercising independent judgment in identifying, reporting, and leading the correction of non-compliances and deficiencies. The successful candidate will serve as a point of contact for regulatory engagement, lead the correction of non-compliance with established security policies and procedures, and develop and improve processes to ensure operational integrity, owning goals and performance targets for their respective region.

The AvSec Manager supports the AIR operation program as the subject matter expert on interpreting, implementing, and validating security requirements, to ensure associates, 3P vendors, visitors, and assets (people, property, and data) are secure and the organization is prepared to properly respond to various security related incidents. The candidate must have a demonstrated ability to exercise independent judgement, utilize their security expertise and management strength to challenge conventional wisdom, think strategically, and communicate effectively.

Key job responsibilities

The AvSec Manager’s responsibilities include prioritizing team resources and tasks in order to meet AvSec’s targets and goals in an ambiguous environment. This position will lead the business to meet aviation security best practices, regulatory compliance, serving as a subject matter expert in aviation security. This position has a key role in hiring and developing the right workforce strategy to meet long-term process targets.

The AvSec Manager’s responsibilities also include identifying and analyzing gaps in compliance with security procedures and regulatory standards, physical security design standards and policies and leading Security Management Systems (SeMS) processes for risk mitigation. Additional responsibilities include developing new and evaluating existing security standards by establishing workflows, Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and operational excellence mechanisms to ensure customer outcomes are data driven, measured and validated.

This is a new and evolving business operation, and AvSec is looking for someone who can introduce best practices and grow as the team’s scale and scope expand.

Additional Responsibilities Include

Set and clarify requirements and expectations with associates and leadership at each facility.
Create security and quality initiatives that continuously improve processes and mitigate deficiencies.
Provide job-specific training to associates and oversee staffing qualifications and ensure required levels are maintained.
Work closely with site leaders and support staff to ensure on-going support for AIR security initiatives and policies.
Work closely with AIR regional leadership and 3P service providers.
Manage timely, ethical, and professional investigations into security incidents and violations.
Serve as Amazon’s representative for Transportation Security Administration (TSA) inspections and inquiries; investigate allegations of regulatory violations and mitigate regulatory enforcement.
Utilize Security Management Systems (SeMS) to identify the root cause for failures and develop mitigating actions to reduce risk.
Conduct visits, assessments, and audits of processes and records.
Implement security and shrinkage control programs to protect assets from loss due to internal/external theft and operational issues.
This role covers a 24/7 operation and you must be able to work all shifts, including nights, weekends and holidays shifts as necessary.

The Span of Authority for this role includes oversite of a single facility within a geographic region. This will include the hiring and development of team members, supporting operational leadership, managing difficult problems, mitigating immediate risks and deciding if escalation is required.

Eligibility Qualifications

This role is regulated by the TSA and is subject to requirements imposed by the U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) because the role will require access to U.S. CBP-regulated areas. Successful candidates must therefore complete all screenings prescribed by the TSA and the U.S. CBP.
Individuals hired into this position will have unescorted access privileges to airport security identification display areas (SIDA). For this reason, eligibility for this role will be limited to individuals who pass a security screening, as required by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), Department of Homeland Security (DHS), and TSA (as applicable).
This position may be subject to Department of Transportation (DOT) drug and alcohol testing. Federal law requires Amazon to determine an applicant's history of DOT drug and/or alcohol violation(s) or refusal(s) to test before hiring applicant into a safety-sensitive position.
This position requires an employee’s full and unimpaired skills and judgment to safely execute their job duties to ensure the safety and security of Amazon AIR personnel, third-party contractors, Airport personnel, cargo, and equipment. This position is therefore designated as a safety sensitive position and is subject to mandatory pre-employment and, where permitted, post-hire drug testing.

A day in the life

The AvSec Manager will ensure the security of Amazon's associates, assets and data at an AIR Cargo facility. You will lead site compliance with TSA regulations, Amazon Policies and Procedures, and local regulations. A successful candidate will leverage their subject matter expertise to assess brand and regulatory risk factors and evaluate opportunities to improve compliance and mitigate discovered risks. You will use independent judgment to investigate cases that would expose the company to regulatory risk, and make recommendations based on an assessment of the risk. This includes developing and driving engagement strategies for Amazon associates and leaders, to drive compliance. A successful candidate will become a subject matter expert on site security infrastructure, policies and procedures, and regulatory compliance. AvSec is a liaison with any law enforcement or government/regulatory officials that visit the site.

Beyond day-to-day operations, you'll contribute to strategic security initiatives. You'll analyze incident trends to identify systemic issues, participate in regional security planning discussions, provide input on policy development, and help shape AvSec's approach to emerging aviation security challenges. This role provides a pathway to develop strategic thinking skills while maintaining strong tactical execution.

About The Team

The AvSec team is responsible for security, loss prevention, and regulatory compliance at Amazon. The organization is built with four core pillars; Security Management Systems, Programs and Quality Assurance, Security Operations, and Credentialing. The organization is committed to identifying and mitigating risk to people, Amazon assets, Amazon brand and regulatory compliance through the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of best-in-class aviation security procedures, standards and guardrails between which Amazon operates. By supporting our customer teams at fulfillment centers and AIR sites to implement process improvements, mitigate risk, resolve equipment issues, and implement new processes to improve performance, AvSec contributes to safe and secure transportation of air cargo to our customers.

Basic Qualifications

4+ years of compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent experience
3+ years of managing food safety and quality in a large-scale retail or manufacturing environment experience
Bachelor's degree in Food Science or related field
Knowledge of retail food code and regulations governing grocery retail at local, state, and federal levels
Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Experience handling confidential information
Experience interacting with local food safety regulators
3+ years of experience in a security or investigations related field or related Bachelor degree.

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of program requirements definition and data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements experience
Professional auditing qualification, or similar risk or compliance credentials
Experience with SQL and Excel
Analytical leader experienced in performance based, action and results-oriented management, strong project manager and effective problem solver.
Ability to assess risks and challenge current practices to develop and deliver innovative solutions to meet or exceed the customer expectations.
Business Continuity experience.

Position Overview

The Information Management Program Manager provides senior leadership for Kiewit’s Industrial District Project Information Management (PIM) Program and Information Management/Document Control organization. This role is responsible for building and leading a high-performing information management function that supports project execution, strengthens governance, develops talent, and drives consistent information practices across the industrial market.

This position partners with engineering and operations leadership, functional leaders, and project teams to standardize execution, improve processes, align systems and workflows, and ensure project information is controlled from startup through final turnover and closeout.

District Overview

Kiewit’s Industrial District delivers complex construction and engineering projects across North America, including advanced technology, power, industrial, and other large-scale markets. Our teams operate in fast-paced project environments that require disciplined execution, strong coordination, and reliable information management. This role is key to helping project teams establish the standards, systems, and controls needed to manage project information effectively throughout the full project lifecycle.

Location

This position may be based in a district or area office, depending on business needs. Candidates must be willing to travel as required to support project assignments.

Responsibilities

District Leadership & Program Ownership

Serve as the district leader and primary champion for the Project Information Management Program.
Lead development, deployment, and continuous improvement of district PIM standards, procedures, playbooks, tools, and assurance processes.
Influence operations, functional leaders, and project teams to align information management requirements with project needs and delivery models.
Establish district-wide governance, metrics, reporting requirements, and assurance processes.
Drive consistency across engineering, procurement, construction, startup, commissioning, turnover, and final records management.
Lead staffing projections, recruiting support, resource planning, and project deployment strategy for Information Management/Document Control personnel.
Develop talent through onboarding, mentoring, career development, succession planning, and leadership coaching.

Trade Partner Information Management

Lead district deployment of Trade Partner Information Management (TPIM) standards and practices.
Establish governance for trade partner submittals, vendor data, design-assist deliverables, delegated design information, quality documentation, and turnover requirements.
Translate client and contract documentation requirements into RFQ, subcontract, vendor, quality, turnover, and final records expectations.
Support pre-award evaluation and onboarding of Trade Partners around systems, submittals, RFIs, quality documentation, delegated design, and turnover requirements.

Systems, Technology & Reporting

Partner with business technology, systems administrators, and project teams to establish systems-of-record and platform governance.
Drive standardization of metadata, numbering, workflows, templates, reporting, and dashboards.
Lead implementation, governance, and optimization of InEight, TeamBinder, SharePoint, Procore, CxAlloy, Power BI, and other approved information platforms.
Develop district metrics and executive dashboards for information readiness, compliance, submittal performance, vendor data, change management, turnover readiness, and final records completion.

Build team capability through onboarding, training, mentoring, career development, and succession planning.
Evaluate emerging industry trends and delivery models and recommend improvements to district standards.

Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR!

KBR’s National Security Solutions team provides high-end engineering and advanced technology solutions to our customers in the intelligence and national security communities. In this position, your work will have a profound impact on the country’s most critical role – protecting our national security.

Innovative Projects: KBR’s work is at the forefront of engineering, logistics, operations, science, program management, mission IT and cybersecurity solutions.
Collaborative Environment: Be part of a dynamic team that thrives on collaboration and innovation, fostering a supportive and intellectually stimulating workplace.
Impactful Work: Your contributions will be pivotal in designing and optimizing defense systems that ensure national security and shape the future of space defense.

Job Title:
Project Manager, Military Space Strategy and Execution

Job Summary

KBR is seeking a Project Manager to advance execution excellence and growth initiatives across the Military Space Division. This role will contribute to the development of standardized program management practices, performance measures, digital resources, and scalable tools that improve program delivery and division-wide operational effectiveness.

The Project Manager will also support organic growth, working with program and operational teams to identify evolving customer needs, adjacent requirements, contract-expansion opportunities, and potential follow-on work. For competitive growth, the role will contribute to market and opportunity assessments, capture planning, solution development, proposal preparation, reviews, and customer presentations.

Working across program operations, business development, technical teams, and functional organizations, the Project Manager will help translate mission needs, customer insights, and delivery best practices into actionable growth strategies, differentiated solutions, and practical improvements to Military Space execution.

Delivery Excellence and Execution Strategy

Lead the development and implementation of the Military Space Performance Excellence framework for program and project execution.
Develop a scalable program management framework aligned with PMBOK principles, KBR best practices, contractual requirements, and customer expectations.
Document standard processes, procedures, roles, templates, and tools that programs can tailor to their specific requirements.
Conduct fact-finding with senior program managers to understand how major programs currently operate, including their processes, digital presence, tools, execution challenges, and effective practices.
Review applicable Performance Work Statements, Contract Data Requirements Lists, and other contractual deliverables to understand program execution and reporting requirements.
Establish key performance indicators and internal performance measures that support delivery excellence, customer satisfaction, and strong CPARS outcomes.
Develop repeatable approaches for monitoring project cost, schedule, technical performance, staffing, risk, quality, deliverables, and customer commitments.
Capture and share lessons learned and effective practices across Military Space programs.
Help programs implement corrective actions and continuous-improvement initiatives based on performance trends and execution needs.

Translate program insights, customer challenges, and execution lessons into actionable growth initiatives.
Support competitive pursuits through market research, capture planning, solution development, proposal preparation, reviews, and oral presentations.

Help operational teams understand their role in business development, customer engagement, organic growth, recompetes, and competitive captures.

Support development and implementation of the Division’s overall strategy, growth priorities, and execution vision.

Experience developing or implementing project management processes, tools, standards, or governance practices.
Experience managing schedules, resources, deliverables, risks, dependencies, and cross-functional stakeholders.
Working knowledge of PMBOK principles and disciplined project-management practices.
Understanding of DoD acquisition, contracting, budgeting, program execution, or technical-review processes.

Experience supporting organic growth, capture, proposal development, customer engagement, or related business development activities.
Strong facilitation, communication, analytical, organizational, and change-management skills.

Experience developing program management offices, delivery-excellence frameworks, or enterprise project-management standards.
Experience with SharePoint site development, project dashboards, performance metrics, and digital collaboration tools.

Date Posted: September 28, 2026

Space Dynamics Laboratory (SDL) is seeking applicants for a Program Manager to provide “Subject Matter Expertise” to the Intercontinental Ballistic Missile Systems Directorate in our C4ISR Systems Division. The successful candidate will serve as an Ogden, UT-based Program Manager with primary responsibility for managing team tasking, coordinating technical activities, and interfacing with U.S. Air Force customers.

The successful candidate will have demonstrated experience with software development and integration, computer networking, hardware and/or cloud infrastructure and cybersecurity, along with experience supporting complex programs. The Command, Control, Communications, Computers, Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (C4ISR) Systems Division delivers mission-critical solutions, specializing in cyber operations, information architecture, strategic deterrence, and ISR. Our division’s commitment to innovation and security enables us to provide critical solutions across defense, intelligence, and national security. Join our team and contribute to the next generation of defense technologies.

Key Responsibilities

Demonstrates an understanding of a customer’s needs and issues, usually by direct interface
Works with the customer to define project tasking and follows-through with project execution
Assembles and directs corporate resources toward execution of the contract
Identifies, tracks, avoids, and mitigates risks
Trades issues of scope, approach, cost, and schedule
Delivers the contracted result
Manages daily activities of an engineering support team

Required Qualifications

Must have a bachelor’s degree
5+ years of project management or technical leadership experience
Demonstrated supervisory experience
Proficiency in task management
Ability to organize and manage a team
Experience leading technical projects
Ability to work in a team-oriented environment while making direct contributions to team success
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Excellent computer skills
Must be a U.S. citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance

Preferred Qualifications

10+ years of project management experience
Bachelor’s or advanced degree in systems, software, data, or cyber engineering
Management and systems engineering experience with DoW/USAF
USAF Nuclear operations or enterprise experience
USAF weapons development and acquisition experience
Hold an active DOW TS Clearance

$104,000 - $160,000
Salary commensurate on education and relevant experience

This range serves as a general guideline and may vary based on factors such as role, level, location, market conditions, and individual qualifications, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Why Join SDL?

SDL offers competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. Visit our Benefits Page to learn more about what we offer.

SDL delivers advanced multi-domain solutions to protect national security and enable scientific discovery. Our expertise in satellites, sensors and instruments, ground systems and data processing, and autonomous systems plays a critical role in missions supporting NASA and the Department of Defense. Join our team of engineers, scientists, technicians, and business professionals in our seventh decade of delivering mission success.

At SDL, we strive to uphold a culture of respect, collaboration, empowerment, and accountability. jobs.title: Security Operations Manager, GSOC, Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS)
jobs.description:
Description

The Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS) Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) is Amazon’s 24/7 centralized command center supporting Worldwide Amazon Stores. The GSOC manages critical incidents impacting life safety, operational continuity, and brand reputation by connecting sites with the appropriate subject matter experts and coordinating end-to-end incident response. We accomplish this by creating policy and implementation guidelines; training leadership and staff; using technology to eliminate subjectivity, complexity, and variation; identifying, preparing for, and mitigating risk; and auditing our practices to ensure compliance.

The Security Operations Manager, Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) will provides critical support and timely notification to global partners regarding incidents that have impacted, or have the potential to impact, Life Safety, Operations, and/or the Amazon Brand. They will assist in managerial ownership of their shift and be responsible for ensuring performance SLAs are met, that responses are appropriate according to policies and procedures, and for developing and motivating a highly performant staff. The Security Operations Manager must also deal effectively with ambiguity and make response-related decisions sometimes with incomplete information in the best interest of Amazon.

The successful candidate must have a proven record of effective leadership capabilities and demonstrate elevated judgment while operating under pressure. They must possess the ability to operate autonomously, use discretion when dealing with sensitive and critical information, and apply sound business principles to identify barriers and initiate actions to resolve. The candidate should possess a proven record of working across multiple organizations to resolve escalations where the problem and solutions, as well as risk strategy, may not be well defined.

The GSOC is a 24/7/365 operation, and this position will require shift work, including night and weekend shifts.

Key job responsibilities

Lead 24/7 GSOC shift operations, ensuring timely triage, escalation, and resolution of incidents impacting life safety, operational continuity, and Amazon’s brand.
Provide timely notifications, situation reports, and executive briefings to global stakeholders
Ensure shift operational excellence by maintaining ownership of performance, achieving established Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and driving consistent execution of policies and procedures
Partner with Security, Operations, HR, Workplace Health & Safety (WHS), Legal, Communications and other internal stakeholders to coordinate effective incident response and business continuity support.
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Operations Security Specialists by setting clear expectations, providing regular coaching and feedback, and fostering a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous learning.
Monitor incident trends, operational metrics, and emerging risks to identify opportunities for process improvements, strengthen response capabilities, and reduce recurring issues.
Lead post-incident reviews and drive corrective actions that improve operational resilience, standardize best practices, and enhance the effectiveness of global incident management.
Partner with cross-functional and global teams to develop, implement, and continuously improve processes, tools, and operational standards that support scalable, efficient GSOC operations.
Maintain the highest standards of professionalism, sound judgment, confidentiality, and customer obsession while protecting Amazon’s associates, operations, and brand.

A day in the life

As a GSOC Security Operations Manager, you will lead a team responsible for managing critical security and operational incidents across Amazon’s global network. Your day may include directing responses to workplace emergencies, severe weather events, security threats, transportation incidents, or operational disruptions while coordinating with multiple business partners and executive stakeholders. You will coach your team in real time, provide strategic guidance during escalations, ensure operational metrics are met, and continuously improve processes that strengthen Amazon’s global incident management capability.

Basic Qualifications

7+ years of conducting workplace risk investigations experience
Experience in conducting workplace risk investigations
Experience leveraging technology to drive process improvements
Experience managing direct reports
Bachelor's degree or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

7+ years of customer-facing environment experience
CPA, CMA, CISA, CIA or equivalent risk, audit, or compliance credentials
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification
Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
Experience working in a customer-facing environment
Experience with physical security control and surveillance systems
Master's degree or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. jobs.title: AVP, Business Intelligence Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

SiriusPoint is a specialty underwriter providing solutions to clients and brokers around the world. Bermuda-headquartered with offices in New York, London, Stockholm and other locations, we are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (SPNT). We have licenses to write Property & Casualty and Accident & Health insurance and reinsurance globally. Our offering and distribution capabilities are strengthened by a portfolio of strategic partnerships with Managing General Agents and program managers. With over $3.0 billion total capital, SiriusPoint’s operating companies have a financial strength rating of A from AM Best, Fitch and S&P, and A3 from Moody’s.

Join Our Team

You will be our AVP, Business Intelligence Manager, accountable for the strategy, delivery, adoption, and governance of enterprise reporting, dashboards, and analytics. You will lead and develop the BI team, partner with business and technology leaders, and ensure that trusted data is translated into actionable insights that support decision-making across SiriusPoint. You will be instrumental in evolving SiriusPoint's BI practice from traditional reporting to AI-driven decision intelligence, guiding the team and stakeholders in designing and delivering enterprise analytical datasets, semantic models, and business ontologies that enable trusted, scalable self-service analytics. The role will use Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and emerging AI technologies to transform governed enterprise data into business-ready data products. This role combines people leadership, stakeholder management, delivery accountability, and hands-on BI expertise. You will help mature our cloud-based reporting capabilities across AWS Redshift, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and other scalable data solutions.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

BI Strategy, Governance, and Operating Model

Define and maintain the BI roadmap, priorities, standards, and delivery approach in alignment with enterprise data and technology strategy.
Establish consistent practices for dashboard design, KPI definitions, data lineage, documentation, testing, release management, and ongoing support.
Embed AI across the BI delivery lifecycle, from requirements and data modeling through development, testing, documentation, and support, to increase speed, quality, and consistency.
Partner with data governance, architecture, security, and business teams to improve the trust, accessibility, and appropriate use of information.
Drive adoption, data literacy, and a self-service analytics culture while maintaining appropriate controls and stewardship.

Team Leadership and Delivery

Lead, coach, and develop BI engineers and analysts, setting clear objectives, accountabilities, and development plans.
Build AI fluency across the team and embed AI-driven ways of working into everyday BI delivery.
Own demand intake, prioritization, capacity planning, and delivery commitments for the BI portfolio.
Create a transparent delivery cadence with clear plans, risks, dependencies, decisions, and stakeholder communications.
Balance strategic platform improvements with business reporting needs, production support, and technical debt reduction.

Business Partnership and Insight

Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders to understand business outcomes, define meaningful measures, and translate needs into scalable BI solutions.
Oversee the development and maintenance of executive dashboards, operational reporting, and analytical products across insurance and corporate functions.
Ensure insights are communicated clearly, with appropriate context, to support decisions, identify trends, and highlight opportunities and risks.
Evolve the practice from static report production toward AI-augmented insight, such as automated anomaly detection, forecasting, and plain-language explanation of results.
Partner with business teams to rationalize reports, strengthen KPI ownership, and reduce duplicative or inconsistent reporting.
Lead a community of practice to strengthen collaboration, standards, and adoption.

Technology, Data Quality, and Controls

Provide technical leadership across Power BI, SQL, AWS Redshift, semantic models, ETL processes, and related cloud technologies.
Ensure solutions meet expectations for performance, scalability, usability, resilience, security, and maintainability.
Implement quality controls for data validation, reconciliation, access, change management, and production monitoring.
Set review and validation standards for AI-assisted development and AI-generated insights so that outputs remain accurate, explainable, and auditable.
Partner with data engineering and architecture teams on source integration, platform enhancements, and reusable data products.

Your Skills And Abilities Should Include

Progressive experience in business intelligence, reporting, analytics, or data engineering, including leadership of teams and complex delivery portfolios.
Demonstrated ability to lead managers, engineers, or analysts and to build a high-performing, service-oriented team.
Strong hands-on knowledge of Power BI, SQL, and modern data platforms; experience with AWS Redshift and cloud-based data ecosystems is strongly preferred.
Experience defining BI standards, governance, operating practices, and scalable reporting architectures.
Strong understanding of data modeling, semantic layers, ETL or ELT, data quality, security, and performance optimization.
Understanding of semantic layers and knowledge graphs/ontologies as the foundation for AI.
Insurance or reinsurance experience is preferred, including familiarity with policy, claims, underwriting, finance, or actuarial data.
Experience applying AI to modernize how BI is designed, delivered, and consumed, with sound judgment on quality, risk, and governance.
Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, facilitation, and presentation skills.
Demonstrated ability to influence across a global organization, manage competing priorities, and make pragmatic, risk-informed decisions.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data analytics, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

jobs.title: Credit Research Analyst
jobs.description:
Credit views on this bank's covered issuers currently rely on periodic reviews that go stale between rating cycles, and a global bank standing up its India technology and operations centre has partnered with Flexiple to hire a Credit Research Analyst who will keep those views current on its India credit research desk.
The desk you'd support

This desk covers a portfolio of corporate and financial issuers, tracking their credit profile, capital structure and covenant headroom, and feeding that analysis into the rating views and internal credit opinions used across lending, trading and risk functions. The work sits close to real decisions: a stale credit view here can show up as a mispriced position or a missed covenant breach somewhere else in the bank.
How a rating call gets made

Building and maintaining financial models for covered issuers, including leverage, coverage and liquidity metrics
Tracking covenant compliance, rating actions and credit events across the assigned portfolio
Drafting credit notes and issuer updates that summarise financial performance against thesis and triggers
Supporting senior analysts on new issuer onboarding, including first-pass credit write-ups
Monitoring macro, sector and regulatory developments that could move an issuer's credit profile

What we're looking for in a first read

2 to 6 years of experience in credit research, corporate ratings, fixed income research or related credit analysis, with strong financial modelling skills and comfort reading financial statements, indentures and credit agreements. You should be able to write a credit note that a senior analyst can sign off on with minimal rework, and be precise about assumptions in a leverage or coverage model.
Where the seat sits

The role is based out of Mumbai, Bengaluru, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad or Pune, or Remote (India), working alongside a global credit research function with regular touchpoints across time zones.
After you apply

The process includes an HR Screening, a modelling or case assignment, a Technical Round with the credit team and a final Culture Fit conversation. One application here covers this opening and any other Flexiple-matched role that fits your experience, so there is no need to reapply.

jobs.description:
About The Role

The Manufacturing Data Analyst plays a critical role in transforming raw manufacturing data into actionable insights that drive operational efficiency and product quality improvements. This position involves analyzing complex datasets from production lines, identifying trends, and providing data-driven recommendations to optimize manufacturing processes. The analyst collaborates closely with engineering, quality assurance, and production teams to support continuous improvement initiatives and reduce waste. By leveraging advanced analytical techniques and tools, the role ensures that manufacturing decisions are supported by accurate and timely data. Ultimately, the Manufacturing Data Analyst contributes to enhancing overall manufacturing performance and competitiveness in the market.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.
Proficiency in data analysis tools such as SQL, Excel, and statistical software (e.g., R, Python).
Experience working with manufacturing data or in a manufacturing environment.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Excellent communication skills to effectively convey complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience.
Familiarity with manufacturing execution systems (MES) and enterprise resource planning (ERP) software.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms.
Knowledge of Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
Programming experience in Python or R for advanced data analysis and automation.

Responsibilities

Collect, clean, and analyze manufacturing data from various sources including production equipment, sensors, and enterprise systems.
Develop and maintain dashboards and reports to monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to production efficiency, quality, and downtime.
Identify patterns, anomalies, and root causes of manufacturing issues through statistical analysis and data mining techniques.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design experiments and pilot projects aimed at process optimization and defect reduction.
Present findings and actionable insights to stakeholders through clear visualizations and detailed reports to support decision-making.

Skills

The Manufacturing Data Analyst uses required skills such as SQL and Excel daily to extract and manipulate large datasets from manufacturing systems, ensuring data accuracy and completeness. Statistical software like R or Python is employed to perform in-depth analyses, identify trends, and build predictive models that inform process improvements. Communication skills are essential for translating complex analytical results into clear, actionable insights that can be understood by production and management teams. Preferred skills like familiarity with MES and ERP systems enhance the analyst’s ability to integrate data from multiple sources, providing a comprehensive view of manufacturing operations. Additionally, expertise in data visualization tools allows the analyst to create intuitive dashboards that facilitate real-time monitoring and decision-making.

All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience.

As a Prime Video technologist, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!

Prime Video is on a mission to reimagine how customers discover and engage with content across the entertainment landscape. As part of this vision, we’re investing heavily in building scalable, science-friendly infrastructure to accelerate the pace of innovation in machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI). We’re seeking a Principal Engineer to lead the technical direction of our next-generation Recommender Systems (RecSys) platforms — systems that sit at the core of how customers experience Prime Video.

About The Team

Prime Video Personalization and Discovery (PVPD) is dedicated to creating a highly personalized content discovery experience that not only delights our customers but also drives both short-and long-term business goals. Our scope includes personalized recommendations, search, marketing, and the advanced machine learning technology and infrastructure that underpins these experiences. Our mission is to automate and enhance customer engagement through personalization, using ML and Generative AI.

Key Job Responsibilities

In this role, you will partner closely with applied scientists, product teams, and platform engineers to define and deliver highly extensible systems that fuel personalized discovery at scale. you will lead the technical strategy and architecture of Prime Video’s end-to-end personalization stack — spanning data ingestion, feature engineering, training and serving platform, candidate retrieval, multi-stage ranking, dynamic content grouping, whole page optimization, and orchestration. Your work will shape how millions of customers discover content they love, optimizing for engagement, retention, and long-term customer value.

You will bring clarity to ambiguity, complexity, ROI, planning, and trade-off etc that dramatically improves the agility, usability, and extensibility of our ML solutions. Your technical leadership will shape the future of AI/ML across Prime Video, unlocking generative and ML models that personalize content for hundreds of millions of viewers worldwide.

Key job responsibilities

Consistently meet challenging deadlines and deliver high-quality solutions that enable the Prime Video platform to scale to meet growing customer demand.
Overcome obstacles and persist in the face of setbacks to ensure critical initiatives are successfully completed.
Proactively identify and mitigate risks, communicating regularly with stakeholders on project status and issues.
Demonstrate deep technical expertise in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, ML/AI fluency and large-scale data processing.
Understand the architecture and design limitations of the existing Prime Video systems, ML models, and drive technical decisions that address deficiencies and optimize performance.
Use data-driven analysis to make a compelling case for project priorities and resource allocation.
Accountable for the overall strategy and successful execution of large, complex infrastructure optimization and scaling programs.
Partner closely with engineering, product, and business leaders to align initiatives with high-level objectives and achieve measurable improvements in efficiency or customer experience.
Communicate ideas effectively to a wide range of audiences, foster constructive dialogue, and lead the resolution of contentious technical issues.
Set a best-in-class example for project/program management practices, driving crisp decision-making and proactive risk mitigation.

Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

The HR Knowledge and Intelligence Manager owns the structure, governance, quality, and continuous improvement of HR knowledge across the enterprise. This role helps transform fragmented HR content, policy guidance, process information, decisions, and institutional expertise into trusted knowledge that employees, leaders, HR professionals, and approved AI agents can find and apply with confidence.

Work Location

This is a remote opportunity open to candidates located anywhere in the U.S.

The Main Responsibilities

Define and maintain the HR knowledge and intelligence strategy, roadmap, operating model, governance approach, and success measures aligned to HR priorities and enterprise AI direction.
Create order from fragmented HR knowledge by leading discovery, inventory, taxonomy, metadata, source-of-truth, ownership, and lifecycle standards across approved repositories and systems.
Identify and coordinate resolution of duplicate, outdated, conflicting, incomplete, inaccessible, or ownerless content with the appropriate HR domain owners.
Build and manage a coordinated HR knowledge agent workforce, including agent purpose, work boundaries, instructions, queues, access, quality expectations, escalation paths, and controls.
Partner with HR, AI, technology, legal, privacy, security, data, communications, and records-management teams to make HR knowledge reliable, discoverable, governed, and ready for responsible AI use.
Design functional readiness and quality tests to confirm agents retrieve authoritative sources, preserve context, recognize exceptions, cite evidence where required, and escalate appropriately.
Establish a balanced scorecard for knowledge coverage, ownership, freshness, findability, duplication, conflict resolution, retrieval quality, user outcomes, and agent performance.
Drive adoption of clear, accessible, plain-language HR knowledge practices while preserving policy precision, confidentiality, legal meaning, and local or workforce-specific variation.

What We Look For In a Candidate

Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
7+ years of progressive experience in knowledge management, content strategy, information architecture, HR operations, HR service delivery, governance, organizational learning, or a related discipline.
3+ years leading a complex cross-functional capability, program, or body of work with accountability for standards, governance, decision-making, and measurable outcomes.
Strong understanding of HR functions, HR operating models, employee services, policy and process ownership, and sensitive employee-related information.
Experience creating taxonomies, metadata standards, source-of-truth models, content standards, governance practices, or knowledge lifecycle controls.
Working fluency with generative AI and AI agents, including defining agent work, setting guardrails, evaluating outputs, identifying failure patterns, and determining when human judgment is required.
Strong written communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and influencing skills with the ability to align decision makers across functions.
Sound judgment regarding privacy, confidentiality, access, records, legal or regulatory considerations, and responsible AI use.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience in a large, complex, highly matrixed, distributed, or regulated organization.
Experience with enterprise HR platforms, employee-service technologies, content-management systems, enterprise search, or collaboration repositories.
Experience supporting AI retrieval, grounding, semantic search, knowledge graphs, ontologies, retrieval-augmented generation, agent evaluation, or related capabilities.
Experience in process redesign, service design, change leadership, or federated governance models.

The Program Manager develops program processes and resources, coordinates multiple stakeholders, monitors progress and outcomes, and identifies opportunities to strengthen program operations and the student experience.

The Program Manager serves as a key student-facing administrative resource and works closely with the MSTP Coordinator, providing functional direction on shared projects and overseeing operational implementation within the Manager's areas of responsibility.

Responsibilities

Manage the MD-PhD application screening, interview, and admissions decision release process, including workflows, assignments, scheduling, interviewer participation, applicant communications, and virtual interview programming.
Serve as a primary program resource for Admissions Committee members and student volunteers, providing guidance, training, resources, and ongoing support, and recruit and prepare students to participate in admissions and recruitment activities.
Translate program recruitment priorities into outreach programming, content and messaging, and represent the MSTP at national conferences, webinars, fairs, and other events.
Manage systems and processes for tracking MD-PhD student progression, academic requirements, Individual Development Plans, course registration, and other program milestones across all phases of training.
Serve as a key student-facing administrative resource for program requirements, milestones, academic transitions, and administrative processes, connecting students with appropriate faculty and institutional resources as needed.
Lead student onboarding from matriculation through New Student Orientation and coordinate programming and resources that support students through major transitions between the medical school and PhD phases of MD-PhD training.
Develop and oversee academic, professional development, clinical, community-building, and student engagement programming, including the annual MSTP Retreat and other major program initiatives, while overseeing logistical implementation by the MSTP Coordinator.
Lead program communications and publications, including reintroducing and managing the MSTP newsletter, developing and updating the program brochure and other promotional materials, and contributing substantively to the Annual MSTP Report.
Manage program data, dashboards, trackers, surveys, and other systems supporting admissions, student milestones, programming, assessment, and decision-making; analyze data and feedback to identify opportunities for program and process improvement.
Manage trainee and program data and reporting workflows supporting the MSTP T32 training grant, annual RPPR, and competitive renewal, ensuring required information is complete, accurate, and organized in support of the Administrative Director’s oversight.
Manage day-to-day financial administration for assigned program activities, including purchase orders, reimbursements, invoices, and related financial transactions within established budget parameters.
Collaborate with MSTP leadership, GSBS, Medical Education, faculty, students, alumni, and other institutional partners to coordinate program initiatives and support alignment across the MD-PhD training continuum.

They provide executive leaders with insight into all investments and growth initiatives, bringing clarity to complex decision-making. The successful candidate will play a crucial role in providing financial insights to stakeholders, supporting planning and forecasting activities, and contributing to the build and development of FP&A tools - with a core focus on bank balance sheet modeling, capital allocation, and regulatory ratio calculations.

In This Role You Will

Develop, own, and maintain bank balance sheet and capital allocation models to optimize net interest income (NII), manage liquidity, and inform asset-liability management (ALM) strategy (such as allocating balance sheet capacity to various asset alternatives).
Familiarity with forward flow, ABS-style structures
Incorporate regulatory capital and liquidity ratio considerations (e.g., LCR, NSFR, CET1, Tier 1 Leverage) into integrated financial planning, stress testing, and scenario analysis.
Develop and maintain financial models for strategic planning, budgeting, forecasting, and scenario planning
Perform variance analysis to identify financial discrepancies and provide insights
Ensure data accuracy and completeness through data cleansing and quality assurance procedures
Build and prepare reports to communicate financial findings and recommendations
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather data and support financial planning initiatives
Build and improve cashflow planning processes and analytics
Support the development of cost allocations and profitability analytics
Clearly communicate financial data and analysis to stakeholders
Document financial models and assumptions to ensure transparency and maintain institutional knowledge
Demonstrate a mindset that balances operational excellence and continuous improvement
Prepare ad hoc financial reporting and analysis as needed to support decision-making
Perform all other duties as assigned

Qualifications

4-6+ years of experience in FP&A, Corporate Treasury, or Asset-Liability Management (ALM) - ideally within a Corporate Treasury division at a major financial institution or a high-growth Fintech preferred
Deep proficiency in balance sheet modeling, including interest rate risk (IRRBB), capital planning, and bank regulatory frameworks.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field
Experience building and maintaining financial models
Skilled at analyzing financial data to identify trends, patterns, and key insights
Proficient in Microsoft Excel, with additional skills in FP&A software like Vena and use of AI software preferred
Intellectually curious
Strong attention to detail, judgment, and analytical skills
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment

jobs.description:
As Senior Project Manager, you will be part of a leadership team dedicated to providing world class service to our clients by leading the day-to-day management of the project. You will create a project plan that outlines the tasks, timelines, and resources required to achieve the project’s goals. The Senior Project Manager will communicate with the project stakeholders, manage risk and monitor progress against the schedule. Successful candidates will demonstrate a passion for and dedication to getting the job done.

Responsibilities

Lead all activities related to contract administration, change orders, procurement, schedule, and financial reporting
Have thorough knowledge of the company's contracts and understanding of all parties involved
Secure required permits and verify insurance coverage for subcontractors
Facilitate project meetings to successfully coordinate work activity
Lead, train, and develop project team members
Prepare and submit monthly job status reports that outline project priorities and issues
Lead project close-out of project; including turnover of manuals and warranties and preparation of final payment documents for subcontractors
Develop and maintain positive working relationships with counterparts at owner, engineering, and design firms
Establish a deadline and monitor the progress of the project
Participate in proposals and presentations as requested
Drive a culture of safety on the project site
Support the company’s acquisition of new work by participating in proposals and presentations
Provide leadership to foster an environment of inclusion and diversity
Proactively identify and develop relationships with industry professionals to generate and win the right work
Take an active role in recruiting top industry talent to join the Clark team. Identify, hire, and retain outstanding people
Exceed our stakeholders’ expectations by anticipating their needs, desires, and goals

Basic Qualifications

Undergraduate or graduate degree in engineering, architecture, construction management, a related discipline or relevant work experience
7+ years of construction experience required; working for a general contractor on large scale construction projects is highly preferred. DBIA and LEED Accreditation a plus
4+ years leading, developing, and motivating teams
Understanding of the strategic, operational, and financial components of a construction project
Ability to make timely and effective decisions
Experience managing projects successfully from start to finish
Skilled at developing and negotiating relationships with owners and trade contractors
Strong work ethic, leadership, and the ability to work in a fast paced environment
Alignment to Clark Standards of Excellence: Self-Motivated, Results Oriented, Adaptable, Team Player, Accountable, Ethical, Innovative, Resilient, Builds Relationships, Builds People / Teams and Followership, Sets Direction and Executes

The work environment and requirements described below are representative of those necessary for an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this role.

The Physical Side of the Role:
This is an active, hands-on role. You can expect to be on your feet frequently, navigating active job sites with uneven terrain, stairs, ladders, and hoists. The work is physically demanding and requires a full range of motion, including bending, kneeling, and reaching. You’ll need to be comfortable frequently lifting and carrying materials up to 25 pounds, and occasionally up to 50 pounds. This role requires the ability to communicate effectively, as well as visual acuity for reading plans and inspecting work. The role does include desk time in the office that may require prolonged periods of sitting for tasks like computer work, document review, and meetings.

Your Work Environment:
You’ll spend a significant amount of your time on active construction sites, which means being adaptable to all kinds of weather and moderate to loud noise levels, and comfortable in elevated or confined work areas with moving mechanical equipment and with the fast-paced nature of a project in progress. You will also spend time in a typical office setting with moderate noise levels. Your safety is our top priority, and you'll be expected to follow Clark Construction's safety policies and procedures, and all applicable laws, at all locations.

Our High-Performing Culture:
This is a demanding, high-performance environment. We are looking for candidates who are energized by challenge, thrive under pressure, and are prepared to do what it takes to achieve exceptional results. Success in this role requires significant commitment, including flexibility to work extended hours, especially during critical project phases or client deadlines. Beyond regular working hours, there will be occasions where business needs require your attention, particularly for time-sensitive matters or emergencies. You are expected to monitor and respond to communications (phone calls, emails, text messages) as required to address these situations effectively. Your ability to manage these expectations and be responsive when critical issues arise is key to your success in this role and our collective success as a team.

A Drug Free Workplace:
Clark promotes a drug free workplace. A pre-employment drug “fitness for duty” screening is required, and the company conducts random quarterly drug “fitness for duty” tests.

Clark Civil

Clark Civil performs heavy/civil work including airport, heavy rail, light rail, bridges, interstate road work, electrical substations, water and wastewater treatment, and facilities projects ranging from $10 million to $500 million. Clark Civil delivers projects through a variety of contracting methods, including design/build, construction manager at-risk, and general contracting. With a staff of over 20 percent professional engineers, Clark Civil's projects are led by an experienced heavy/civil technical staff and supported by a multidisciplinary, in-house team. Clark Civil is a division of Clark Construction Group, LLC

Clark offers a total compensation package that includes base salary, bonus potential, and a comprehensive benefits package including health/dental/vision benefits, paid time off, retirement/401k, and Company Contribution plan. Additional benefits include life insurance, commuter benefit, short & long term disability, fitness reimbursement, FSA, tuition reimbursement, back-up daycare, tutoring & family support benefits, EAP/Work-Life assistance, and a holiday contribution program.
