Job Description

The Program Manager serves as the primary onsite leader responsible for the day-to-day operations, management, programming coordination, and community engagement activities of the Discovery & Innovation Hub (DIH) located within the Mount Sinai Harlem Health Center.

Reporting to the Director of DIH, the Program Manager ensures the DIH operates as a dynamic, welcoming, and highly functional innovation ecosystem that supports students, faculty, entrepreneurs, community partners, and external collaborators. This role combines program management, operational leadership, stakeholder engagement, and facility coordination to advance DIH's mission of fostering innovation, entrepreneurship, workforce development, and community-centered impact.

The Program Manager is expected to maintain a consistent onsite presence at the DIH office located at the Mount Sinai Harlem Health Center and serve as the primary point of contact for all activities taking place within the DIH.

Role Context within OPED

Embedded Within OPED’s Academic Community & Culture Core, DIH Functions As a Shared Institutional Resource Aligned With MedEd, GSBS, GME, Faculty Affairs, And Community Partners. The Program Manager Contributes To

Supporting the integration of DIH programs with OPED’s broader professional engagement strategy
Facilitating operational and administrative execution of innovation, digital health engagement, and community partnership initiatives
Enabling cross-functional alignment and communication across institutional stakeholders
Ensuring program activities are executed effectively and meet quality and impact expectations

Responsibilities

Plan, coordinate, and execute DIH programs, workshops, fellowships, speaker series, community engagement initiatives, and special events, ensuring a high-quality experience for participants and partners.

This is an onsite position based at the Discovery & Innovation Hub located within the Mount Sinai Harlem Health Center. The Wealth Management division is seeking a Senior Analyst (Business Intelligence) to support the Sales Performance Analytics and Compensation Incentives Manager. This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop deep expertise in financial analytics, sales performance measurement, and incentive compensation plan administration. As a key member of the analytics team, you will work closely with the Manager, assisting with day-to-day operations and gradually expanding responsibilities to support the division during peak periods and manager absences. Analytics & Reporting

Integrate and validate data from multiple systems (CRM, financial platforms, etc.) to create coherent datasets for analysis

new_jobs.title: Senior FP&A & Treasury Strategy Analyst
new_jobs.description:
About Lead

Lead is a banking infrastructure platform trusted by the most innovative companies to power complex financial products. We enable fintechs to offer compliant, programmable services like payments, lending, and digital assets at scale. Banking has moved beyond traditional institutions and is now embedded directly into everyday experiences, meaning companies need modern infrastructure that is safe, secure, and operationally sound.

Today, Lead is one of the only API-first, developer-focused partner banks with the financial, regulatory, and legal expertise required to help fintechs succeed. We operate offices in San Francisco, Sunnyvale, and New York City, and an FDIC-insured bank in Kansas City.

Financial Planning & Analysis Team at Lead

The Financial Planning & Analysis team ensures Lead's future by turning financial and operational data into actionable business strategy. Working closely with all team heads, they are responsible for budgeting, forecasting, scenario modeling, performance reporting, and strategic advising. They provide executive leaders with insight into all investments and growth initiatives, bringing clarity to complex decision-making. Their work guarantees that the company allocates resources thoughtfully and executes against its goals. It's a team built for analytical problem solvers who demonstrate great attention to detail, enjoy seeing the bigger picture, and want to learn and grow as a fast-growing fintech bank evolves.

Role Description

We are looking to hire a Senior FP&A & Treasury Strategy Analyst to join a growing team of finance and accounting professionals. new_jobs.description:
Important Notice For Applicants

At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates. Official communication will come from an email address ending in @bixal.com or from @bixal.na.teamtailor-mail.com. Messages from other sources may be fraudulent, and you should exercise care to avoid any links or attachments included.

Bixal will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?

If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at talent@bixal.com and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our Values

People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.
Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.
Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.
Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Program Manager to lead delivery of data.CMS.gov, the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services' (CMS) open data platform, which hosts more than 170 data products used by researchers, policymakers, providers, and the public. As the primary strategic and delivery lead, you will own the product roadmap, run a cross-functional agile team of 15 to 25 people, and serve as the main partner to the CMS Office of Enterprise Data and Analytics (OEDA) and data owners across eight CMS components. You will guide the platform's next phase positioning data.CMS.gov as the single destination for CMS public data. This role suits a leader with deep CMS and open data experience who can turn stakeholder priorities into measurable results.

This is a full-time position contingent on contract award with a defined performance period of a nine month base period and four option years .

You’ll have the opportunity to join a project that directly supports Bixal’s mission of improving how government serves people. While the project has a defined timeline, we believe in open communication and proactive career support. You’ll be kept informed of contract status — and we’ll be here to help you grow into what’s next, whether within this project or beyond it.

Location:

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA with occasional travel to CMS headquarters in Baltimore, MD. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship. 

Compensation

The salary range for this role is $120,000 – $130,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities

Lead and manage a cross-functional delivery team, and scale staffing as optional tasks and surge support are authorized.
Own the product strategy and rolling roadmap, prioritize the backlog by desirability, feasibility, and viability, and update the roadmap at the start of each Program Increment (PI).
Lead the agile cadence: two-week sprints, three-sprint PIs, planning, demos, retrospectives, and the Scrum of Scrums.
Oversee all task order management, including project and sprint planning, financial tracking, and estimate at completion.
Produce the Monthly Status Report covering accomplishments, risks, QASP performance, financials, velocity and staffing. Produce the Project Status Dashboard to provide visibility into progress, defects and risks at all times, drawing on live Jira and Confluence data.
Develop and maintain the QASP, and report performance against its metrics and the SOO key results.
Identify risks, blockers, and dependencies early and bring them to CMS with a proposed path forward.
Serve as the primary point of contact for CMS, including the COR and CO and Product Owners.
Coordinate with the Office of Communications and over eight CMS data-owning components, and onboard new data owners as needed.
Plan and deliver at least 10 new data product releases per contract year.
Oversee help desk operations, user communications, outreach, and presentations for CMS leadership.
Apply open data standards and strengthen data and content governance through standard guides and editorial workflows.
Coordinate with other CMS contractors in cross-contractor forums as directed by the COR.
Lead transition-in activities to ensure a continuity of services, reaching full operational capability within six months, and deliver the Transition-Out Plan 90 days before the end of performance.
Other relevant duties as assigned and qualified/trained to perform.

Qualifications

Master's degree in management, public administration, IT, or a related field.
Minimum 10 years of relevant program or project management experience.
Minimum 4 years on open data projects, with demonstrated expertise in DCAT-US 3.0 [RF1] ￼.
Minimum 4 years working directly with CMS programs or data.
Experience managing cross-functional teams, with the ability to lead 15–25 people.
Deep knowledge of Agile product management principles, including sprint planning, backlog management and release planning.
Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Slack, and GitHub.
Ability to oversee all aspects of task order management, including reporting, sprint planning, and project planning.
Experience facilitating stakeholder engagement across multiple CMS components and data owners.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including briefing government leadership.
This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination in support of a federal government contract.

Nice To Have

PMP, SAFe, Certified ScrumMaster, or equivalent agile certification.
Experience with Drupal-based public websites or large public data platforms.
Familiarity with CMS security and ATO processes, Section 508, and WCAG 2.1 AA.
Experience with hosting migrations or website consolidation projects.

How We Support Our Team

Flex hours
401K with matching incentive
Parental Leave
Medical/dental/vision benefits
Flex Spending Account
Company provided short-term disability and life insurance
Commuter benefits
Paid Time Off (PTO)
11 Paid holidays

Our company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all individuals and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

We leverage technology, communications, data, and human-centered design to help governments and leading organizations be more efficient, effective, and impactful.

About Liquid I.V.

This job description indicates in general the nature and levels of work, knowledge, skills, abilities and other essential functions expected of the role. It is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required. It is not intended to limit or in any way modify the right of any supervisor to assign, direct, and control the work of employees under his/her supervision. Ability to competently perform all the essential duties of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation, demonstrated commitment to the company’s mission, and the ability to work productively as a member of a team or work group are basic requirements of all positions at Liquid I.V.

We are committed to building an inclusive culture of belonging that not only embraces the diversity of our people but also reflects the diversity of the communities in which we work and the customers we serve. We know that the happiest and highest performing teams include people with diverse perspectives that encourage new ways of solving problems, so we strive to attract and develop talent from all backgrounds and create workplaces where everyone feels seen, heard, and empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work.

Liquid I.V. is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

About Our Team

We are a world-class team of innovators and passionate change-makers, looking to develop transformative hydration solutions and make a meaningful impact on the world around us.

At Liquid I.V., we are committed to building an inclusive culture of belonging that not only embraces the diversity of our people but also reflects the diversity of the communities in which we work and the customers we serve.

Our team members enjoy a flexible and inclusive working environment, a highly collaborative and innovation-forward culture, generous benefits and perks that empower employees to champion their wellbeing every day, as well as an infinite supply of Liquid I.V. for extraordinary hydration.

About The Role

Liquid I.V. is seeking an exceptional Marketing Project Manager who already knows how to do this job. We’re not looking for someone to develop - we’re looking for someone to trust. This is a cornerstone role for a PM who has mastered the craft, commands a room, and operates with the kind of ownership that makes a cross-functional team’s job easier, not more challenging.

You don’t need to be taught how to PM - you’ve been doing it at a high level long enough that your instincts are already calibrated. What you will need to navigate is a fluid, fast-moving environment with competing priorities, strong department leads, and a campaign calendar that doesn’t slow down for anyone. The learning curve here isn’t the craft - it’s the terrain which you’ll need to figure out fast.

Beyond execution, this role carries a meaningful leadership mandate. You will be a steadied PM who strategizes when things get complicated. You’ll be joining a PM team that is rooted in everything the Brand Marketing initiates and executes.

The ideal candidate is deeply fluent in the brand marketing and creative landscape - comfortable navigating packaging timelines, AOR partnerships, LTO’s, product innovation partnerships and progess, digital marketing collaboration, global asset governance, and cross-functional 360 campaign orchestration with equal confidence. You know what good looks like, you hold the team to it, and you make the work better by being in the room.

Functions and duties of this role include, but not limited to:

Campaign Leadership - Growth Driving & Big Bet

Own end-to-end project management for Tier 1 and high-priority campaign workstreams - including 360 brand campaigns, seasonal launches, and growth-driving initiatives - from brief intake through post-launch evaluation.
Lead cross-functional project teams across Brand, Creative, Media, Retail, Production, and agency partners, driving clarity on scope, timelines, milestones, and deliverables.
Manage and maintain project timelines in Wrike, ensuring all workstreams are visible, up-to-date, and escalated when at risk.
Partner with the AOR (Agency of Record) as the primary Marketing Ops point of contact on campaign development and production workstreams.
Facilitate campaign stage gate reviews, briefing sessions, and alignment meetings - ensuring the right stakeholders are in the room and decisions are captured and actioned.
Proactively identify, document, and escalate risks, blockers, and scope changes before they impact delivery timelines.

Brand Marketing & Creative Fluency

Navigate PMO packaging artwork timelines with a working understanding of dielines, print production stages, approvals, and vendor handoffs.
Manage PDP (Product Detail Page) asset deliverables across retailer and DTC channels, ensuring assets meet spec requirements and are delivered on time.
Understand and govern asset output requirements across a 360 campaign: video, photography, digital, social, retail, and print - including full funnel development and placement.
Apply working knowledge of global asset sharing practices to ensure creative output is properly formatted, named, and accessible to domestic and international stakeholders.
Partner with Creative and Production leads to maintain a clear picture of asset status, version control, and delivery across all active campaigns.

Team Leadership & Mentorship

Serve as a project coach for PM team peers - modeling best-in-class project management practices and providing day-to-day guidance on execution challenges.
Act as the PM team’s internal standard-bearer: the person others look to for how to support a brief, manage a timeline, or navigate a cross-functional conflict.
Support the Director of Marketing Operations in identifying and closing skill gaps across the PM team through feedback, coaching, and knowledge sharing.
Step in as the PM lead across the PM team in the Director’s absence, ensuring continuity across all active workstreams.
Contribute to onboarding new PM team members, sharing institutional knowledge and orienting them to tools, processes, and ways of working.

Systems, Process & Operational Excellence

Champion Wrike alongside the Marketing Ops Manager, as the team’s project management system of record - maintaining clean, accurate project data and contributing to platform best practices.
Contribute to ongoing process design across the Marketing Ops function - identifying gaps, proposing improvements, and helping to build and document the team’s ways of working.
Maintain a campaign-level status view across all owned workstreams and provide regular reporting to the Director of Marketing Operations.
Lead or contribute to post-mortem reviews at the close of key campaigns, capturing learnings and translating them into process improvements.
Partner with the Marketing Operations Manager on cross-functional systems initiatives, contributing expertise on how campaign execution intersects with asset, brief, and workflow governance.

Qualifications

The successful candidate will have the following qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
10+ years of project management experience within a brand marketing, in-house creative, or agency environment - consumer goods or CPG brand experience strongly preferred.
Deep fluency in the brand marketing and creative production landscape: you understand how a 360 campaign is built, what packaging artwork requires, how PDP assets are governed, and what it takes to bring a big-bet initiative to market.
Expert-level proficiency in Wrike or a comparable enterprise PM platform; experience building and maintaining complex multi-workstream project plans.
Working knowledge of global asset sharing practices, including asset naming conventions, file structure standards, version control, and cross-market distribution.
Experience managing AOR and agency partner relationships as a client-side PM; comfortable holding agencies accountable to timelines and deliverable quality.
Proven leadership instincts - you’ve mentored junior PMs, set team standards, or served as the operational anchor others rely on.
Highly organized and detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple high-priority workstreams simultaneously without losing sight of the details that matter.
Strong cross-functional communicator - equally comfortable in a creative review, a packaging milestone meeting, or a senior leadership status update.
Comfortable operating with ambiguity and pace: you don’t wait to be told what to do, you figure out what’s needed and drive toward it.
A natural collaborator who builds trust quickly and holds relationships without sacrificing accountability.

What We Give

100% company-paid medical, dental and vision insurance for employees (PPO, HMO and Kaiser options).
A 401k plan with company match, short and long-term disability coverage.
A generous PTO and sick leave programs that includes 10+ paid annual holidays each year + annual Holiday Office Closure.
Wellness Days (Vitality Day and two Recharge Days).
An Employee Assistance Program
Monthly tech and wellness reimbursement.
A monthly supply of Liquid I.V. for endless hydration!

Work Environment

This role is HYBRID (El Segundo, CA) 1-2 days onsite a week with flexibility for industry events Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

annually. The exact salary is determined by various factors including experience, skills, education, geographic location, internal company equity, and budget.
